people.imagined: In the counting hall at dusk after a long day, she has just read the last figure and slid a thumb ring a turn. She is calm, tall, and watching someone who has come to ask for something.
people.subject: The moment: seated upright at dusk in a window-lit hall, she looks directly at a petitioner and slowly turns one of two counting rings on her thumbs with the other hand. The petitioner's shadow falls across the long table; a single oil lamp has just been lit and a stack of seven ledgers stands squared at her elbow. Face: a long, finely cut, handsome face; smooth fair skin with a faint tan; high cheekbones; level dark eyes, patient and cold; long straight brows; a firm well-shaped mouth, neither smiling nor frowning; a small crease between the brows. Hair: black, in a tall smooth coil held by two plain pins of dark wood. A few fine strands escape at the nape of her neck, the only untidy thing about her. Body: tall, straight-backed, long neck. Her shoulders are level and she sits without touching the chair back. Clothing: a long robe the colour of dusk, a deep violet shading to red-orange at the hem like a sunset, of fine thick hemp; a dusk-violet outer jacket with wide sleeves; a narrow dark sash; at the hip a long sheathed sword with a purple-lightning hue along the lacquered scabbard, its pommel wrapped in plain cord; no jewellery but two broad rings, one on each thumb, in dull gold, clearly visible. The dusk robe has a narrow hem band of ochre, and the jacket's cuffs are fastened with plain brown cord knots. Hands and objects: the hands rest on the table, the right thumb ring half turned. Background: blurred warm window with a fiery sunset and the silhouette of a distant mountain. Behind her a row of tall paper windows glows orange, and on a shelf stand small bronze weights in a descending row. Light: low red-gold sunset light from the upper left. Qi: a faint violet and brown earth shimmer. Expression: composed, calculating, cool. The eyes give nothing away, but the mouth is a little tighter than at rest.

people.imagined: In the treasury, counting. He breathes in, the bone rods at his neck click, and he does not look up for the first moment.
people.subject: The moment: heavy and slow, alone in the dark treasury with one lamp and a heap of old copper coins before him, he breathes in, the string of bone counting rods at his neck clicks, and he lifts his eyes to the viewer. Face: a broad, heavy-jowled, deeply lined face with sallow grey-brown skin, small shrewd deep-set eyes in grey pouches, thick grey brows, a wide flat nose, a downturned mouth, a long vertical crease down each cheek and folds at the neck. Hair: thin white-grey, drawn back into a small plain knot, with a trimmed grey beard cut square and kept short, stiff as wire. Body: big, heavy, broad-shouldered and slow, the belly resting against the table edge and the big hands still. Clothing: a plain brown robe of the finest thick hemp, clean and undecorated, tied with a plain cloth belt, the dusk-violet colour only in a thin collar edge; around his neck a long string of pale ivory-white bone counting rods in a jade case, each a thin stick, clearly visible and big in the frame. Hands and objects: his thick hands rest folded on a coil of old copper cash piled on the table. Background: a blurred dark iron-bound treasury wall, iron straps and rivets glinting on a huge door and a stack of small wooden coin chests at the edge. Light: warm lamp light from the upper left. Qi: a faint heavy brown-gold earth shimmer. Expression: stubborn and guarded, the mouth turned down and the small eyes steady, the look of a man who has already decided not to give you what you came for and grieves anyway.

people.imagined: At the edge of a crowded hall, a lean man alone by a wall. An empty scabbard across his back. A goose passes past a high window and he turns his head to follow it.
people.subject: The moment: standing alone at the edge of a room against a wall, he turns his head to follow a flock of geese through a high window. A flock of geese passes the high window, their calls faint, and everyone else in the hall is busy; he alone stands motionless at the wall. Face: lean, long, grey and weathered; deep lines from nose to mouth; pale grey eyes watching the sky; straight grey brows; a hard narrow nose; a thin mouth held in patient sorrow. A white scar crosses his chin, and the skin under his eyes is thin and dark. Hair: grey, in a neat topknot held by a long grey goose-feather pin pushed through it, clearly visible. Body: lean, straight, standing as a soldier. He stands with his weight even on both feet, as if still in a rank. Clothing: a rust-coloured inner robe and a dusk-violet outer robe of fine hemp, sleeves fastened at the wrists with cords; a grey felt coat collar. On his back: a slim empty scabbard of pale blue-white lacquer across the shoulders, bare of any sword, clearly visible over the shoulder. The goose-feather pin is long and soft grey with a black tip; the empty scabbard's lacquer is the colour of pale frost and its mouth is bound with a silver ring. Hands and objects: arms at his sides, fingers lightly curled. His fingers rest against the seam of his trousers, the thumb of the right hand slightly lifted as though about to grip a hilt that is not there. Background: blurred plain wall and a window with a V of geese flying in the sky. Plain whitewashed plaster, one dark wood beam, and a square of pale sky with the V of birds. Light: pale cold light from the upper left. Qi: a faint grey-brown earth shimmer. Expression: guarded, penitent, quiet. Mild, level, and weighed down by something he has carried for a very long time.

people.imagined: Tapping a wall as he passes, one ear tilted to it. He is small and stooped, listening to the rock. Twelve flags are tucked in his belt.
people.subject: The moment: he leans his ear toward a stone wall and taps it with a knuckle, listening, then glances at the viewer with a mild smile, having stopped in the cut-stone corridor at a wall that rings differently from the others. Face: a small, narrow, lined, pinched and kindly face with weathered brown skin, bright small eyes squinting, thin grey brows, a short nose, a mouth curved up at one side, a deep crease at each cheek and large ears that stand out. Hair: thin grey, combed flat over a dusty scalp into a loose knot. Body: small, stooped and bony-shouldered, one shoulder higher than the other and leaning slightly toward the wall, the hands knotted, the knuckles of the tapping hand chipped and white. Clothing: a dusk-violet robe of fine hemp, clean except for a dusty hem, a rust sash, a belt of old rope with a bronze buckle, and across his back and in the belt twelve small hand flags on short silver-pine poles, each a different faded blue, standing fanned out behind his shoulder like feathers, clearly visible. Hands and objects: the left knuckles tap a grey stone; the right hand holds a battered tin miner's lamp hung by a loop of wire. Background: a blurred dark cut-stone gallery with timber props and lamp glow. Light: warm lamp light from the upper left. Qi: a faint silver-grey glimmer in the stone. Expression: curious, mild and absorbed, pleased and slightly absent, as if the wall has just told him something.

people.imagined: On the night watch at the edge of the ruin, filling the lantern with oil. A green flame lights his square face from below. He has not slept a full night in a century.
people.subject: The moment: at night he stands at the edge of a field of grey ash, one hand cupping a lantern with a steady green flame, looking out past the viewer with a hard stare; the oil has just been refilled and he counts what the grey has taken, as on hundreds of nights alike. Face: square, heavy and weathered, with grey skin, a thick jaw, deep furrows, hooded dark eyes in red-rimmed lids from lamp smoke, heavy black brows, a short flat nose, a tight mouth with the corners pulled down, grey stubble and a long white scar from the corner of the left eye into the beard. Hair: iron-grey, cropped short, plastered with ash and sweat. Body: square, thick, broad-shouldered and solid, planting his boots wide and not shifting his weight. Clothing: an ash-grey hemp robe under a close-fitting grey felt coat of heavy cloth, a dusk-violet collar edge. Hands and objects: his left hand holds up a black iron lantern whose pale green flame lights his face from below; the right hand grips a dull bronze anchor on a chain, the chain in loops over his wrist, the bronze cast with a ring pattern. Background: a blurred night and grey ash plain with the broken black outline of a wall like teeth against the lighter sky, flakes of ash drifting through the green light. Light: sickly green lantern light from below, dark above. Qi: a faint grey-brown shimmer. Expression: bitter and relentless, no weariness in it at all, only a hard patience and the set jaw of a man who intends to be avenged.

people.imagined: At new moon, giving the true figures. His voice never rises. He pushes up the crystal spectacles with one ink-stained finger.
people.subject: The moment: seated behind a desk, he pushes polished crystal spectacles up his nose with one inky finger and looks at the viewer over them. It is the evening of the new moon; he has just finished giving the true figures and removes his spectacles for the first time that day only to push them back on. Face: a thin, pale, narrow face; a long thin nose with the spectacles' two round clear crystal lenses, clearly visible; tired clever brown eyes behind them, magnified; thin straight brows; a small precise mouth; a fine crease between the brows. Two faint red dents mark either side of the nose bridge where the crystal rests. Hair: black, neat, in a small tight topknot. A single thin streak of grey runs back from the left temple. Body: thin, narrow-shouldered, upright. His back is arched slightly forward from a lifetime at a desk, and his shoulders rise when he is afraid. Clothing: a pale ochre inner robe and a rust outer robe of excellent hemp, clean and pressed; sleeves tied back with cords for writing; ink on all the fingertips. The pale ochre inner robe shows only at the collar and wrists, crisp white edging, with no creases at all. Hands and objects: the right forefinger, black to the knuckle with ink, rests on the nose bridge; the left hand holds a small abacus with bone beads. The abacus has bone beads yellowed to the colour of old teeth, and its frame is dark wood worn smooth. Background: blurred tall shelves of boxes and a lamp. Shelves of lidded boxes rise to the dark ceiling behind him; the nearest lid is closed with a thread of red cord. Light: warm lamp light from the upper left. Qi: a faint thin brown-grey earth glimmer. Expression: precise, careful, worried. Dry, composed, and tired about the eyes.

people.imagined: On the boat deck at dusk, mid-song, deep voice, a stern lamp beside him. He is singing the ninth verse for no one in particular.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a boat's stern at dusk with his chin lifted and mouth open in a deep song, one hand on a lit stern lamp. The song's ninth verse has risen in him unasked, and the stern lamp's light is on his open mouth. Face: broad and strong, with a big chest-deep jaw; sun-bronzed, weathered skin; closed or half-closed eyes; thick black brows; a broad nose; a wide mouth open in song; a thick black beard that is streaked with grey-black soot at the edges, clearly visible. His nose has been broken once and sits slightly to the left, and the soot in his beard lies in grey streaks like river silt. Hair: black, tied in a high thick knot. The topknot is bound with a wet leather thong; stray hairs curl at the neck. Body: barrel-chested, short, powerful arms. His chest is so wide the robe stretches across it, and his feet are planted wide on the planks. Clothing: a rust robe of strong hemp with a dusk-violet jacket, sleeves rolled up; at the collar a small round brass stern-lamp clasp. Hands and objects: the right hand rests on a round hanging stern lamp, a warm orange lantern; the left hand beats time on his thigh. The lamp's glass is smoked yellow at the top and swings a little on its hook. Background: blurred dark river, a far shore, a deep red-orange sunset. Behind him the far bank is a line of black reeds, and a strip of the river has turned the colour of beaten copper. Light: low orange sunset and lamp light from the upper left. Qi: a faint blue-grey water shimmer. Expression: moved, strong, grave. His eyes are wet and he does not hide it.

people.imagined: In the maple field at autumn, with a leaf pressed into her clasp, thinking of a tree that stands. Her palms are stained with sap.
people.subject: The moment: in an autumn field she holds up both sap-stained palms and looks at the viewer with an earnest, weary face. It is the first week of autumn on the terraces and she has just taken a maple leaf from a branch to press into her clasp; the tree it came from is young and thin. Face: wiry, lean and weathered; tanned skin; small bright dark eyes; strong thin brows; a thin straight nose; a patient firm mouth; lines at the eyes. Her cheeks are hollow, and her lower lip has a dry crack at the centre. Hair: black with some grey, in a low plain knot. A single grey streak crosses from the forehead to the knot. Body: wiry, tough, slightly stooped. She is narrow but corded, with long hands and a little forward stoop. Clothing: a rust robe of fine hemp with a dusk-violet jacket; at the robe's collar clasp, a bright pressed red maple leaf, clearly visible. The inner robe is ochre, the jacket sleeves are cut short enough to keep out of the sap, and the leather belt is dark with years of stain. Hands and objects: both palms held open and forward, dark amber-brown with stained sap; between them a small gourd. The small gourd between her palms is dark red-brown, stoppered with a wooden plug on a short cord. Background: blurred orange and red maple leaves, a single bare tree behind her. A young maple no taller than her shoulder stands in the foreground to one side, three leaves already red. Light: warm golden autumn light from the upper left. Qi: a faint green-gold haze. Expression: patient, stubborn, hopeful. There is hope in the corners of her eyes that she tries to hold flat.

people.imagined: On the beach of the Evening Isle at last light. He counts on his fingers as he speaks to a dying elder and drops the anchor for the 413th time.
people.subject: The moment: bent old man in a reed cape counting on his fingers, speaking little, looking up from the beach at the viewer. The boat has just grounded on the beach for the 413th time and he lets the anchor drop with a slow wrist. Face: very old; a deeply lined, sun-dark face; sunken cheeks; small clouded pale-brown eyes; sparse white brows; a thin nose; a mouth almost without lips; white stubble. Brown age spots dot his temples, and the whites of his eyes are yellow. Hair: sparse white hair under a reed hat. Body: bent, small, thin shoulders. The spine is bowed so far that his chin is almost level with his collarbone. Clothing: a faded but clean dusk-violet robe of hemp, with a heavy reed rain-cape draped over the shoulders; a rust sash. The reed cape is layered like a thatch roof and dripping at the lowest edge; under it the robe's dusk-violet is almost washed to grey, but the seams are mended with fine stitches. Hands and objects: one thin hand held up, three fingers folded, counting; the other hand rests on a worn dark iron anchor on the sand. His left fingers are held up in the middle of a count, the ring finger folded, trembling a little. Background: a blurred pale beach, dim grey sea and a red low sun. The grave mounds on the beach behind him are low and regular, each with a flat grey stone at its head. Light: faint red-gold light from the upper left. Qi: a faint pale blue-grey water glimmer. Expression: serene, tired, very quiet. His look is gentle and without any fear of what he serves.

people.imagined: At the forge, polishing a blade he cannot stop looking at, murmuring to it. A lightning-shaped scar runs down his arm.
people.subject: The moment: bent over a bare sword blade, he murmurs politely to it and then looks up at the viewer with a gruff, offended frown. He has been polishing the same hand's breadth of blade for an hour and has forgotten the viewer is there until the last second. Face: big, broad, deeply homely, with a lumpy, flat nose; pitted burn scars across both cheeks; uneven small eyes; heavy lowered brows; a thick lower lip; a squarish jaw. Hair: black, short and singed uneven. A burn has left a bald crescent over one ear. Body: huge, thick-armed, a smith's shoulders. His forearms are as thick as another man's calves and his chest is deeply barrelled. Clothing: a rust-coloured robe of strong hemp with a thick leather apron, the sleeves rolled up. On his bare right forearm: a jagged white-pink scar shaped like a lightning bolt from elbow to wrist, bright and clearly visible. The apron is cow leather, black with scale and oil, scorched at the lower corner; the robe's rust is almost hidden under soot. Hands and objects: both big hands hold a long polished sword blade horizontally with a cloth; sparks of blue-white light dance along the blade edge. The cloth he polishes with is soft undyed linen folded in four, and the blade's edge shows a thin line of white light. Background: blurred orange forge glow, anvils, hanging tongs. A row of tongs hangs from hooks, and behind the anvil a heap of unfinished blade blanks glows dull red. Light: orange forge light from the lower left, a blue-white flash on the blade. Qi: a faint blue-white lightning crackle at the steel. Expression: gruff, tender, offended. He looks offended at being interrupted and, under it, almost shy.

people.imagined: On the bay wall in sea wind, a letter read twice and now folded; one look at the visitor's face is all she needs.
people.subject: The moment: on a seaside wall in wind she folds a letter she has read twice and studies the viewer's face once, hard. The sea wind is lifting the corner of the letter she is folding, and she presses it flat with her thumb. Face: a sharp, lean, weathered face; high cheekbones; narrow, sharp, dark eyes; straight, severe brows; a straight narrow nose; a thin, tight mouth; a thin scar through one eyebrow. The scar through her eyebrow splits it in two, and salt has dried white at the corner of her mouth. Hair: black with grey streaks, tightly braided and pinned flat against the head. Body: slim, tall, alert. Her shoulders are square and her feet are apart for balance on the wind-swept wall. Clothing: a long sea-grey coat of heavy fine cloth with a stand collar, a dusk-violet robe beneath; the sleeves tight. The sea-grey coat is double-breasted with horn buttons and is lined in dark blue; the dusk-violet robe shows at the neck and cuffs. Hands and objects: both hands hold a small folded sheet of paper, thumbs pressing the crease. Background: blurred grey sea, boats, a pale bay city with a red sunset behind. A line of small fishing boats rocks in the bay below, and the pale bay city rises in terraces behind a red sky. Light: cold grey-gold light from the upper left. Qi: a faint blue-grey sea shimmer. Expression: suspicious, intent, hard. She is intent and reads the viewer's face like a second letter.

people.imagined: About to begin a hearing. He sets a brass grain scale on the table with great care, adjusts it, and waits until everyone is silent.
people.subject: The moment: seated before a hearing, he sets a small brass grain-weigher's scale on the table with a small click and looks at the viewer sternly while adjusting its pan, the room quiet. Face: square and heavy-featured, with brown skin, a calm severe wide unlined forehead, clear steady dark eyes, level thick brows, a firm mouth and a thick square grey-flecked black beard cut straight across with a white scar cutting it on the left side. Hair: black with grey, in a plain topknot. Body: broad and solid, seated perfectly straight with his hands at the table edge, like a statue. Clothing: a dusk-violet robe of fine hemp pressed with sharp creases over a rust under-robe, and a flat pale ochre sash without any ornament. Hands and objects: both thick-fingered hands hold a small polished brass balance scale, two thin brass discs on three chains each, one pan slightly lower; a row of small brass weights lies in a line before him from smallest to largest. Background: a blurred plain wall of dark polished wood with a single high window and a stack of folded contracts at his right. Light: even light from the upper left. Qi: a faint grey-brown shimmer. Expression: stern, fair and immovable, no hostility in it, only a flat and absolute attention.

people.imagined: On the harbour quay in a sea wind, a roll of old sea charts clamped under his arm, squinting out beyond the horizon, where he believes a fleet went.
people.subject: The moment: on a harbour wall he squints out to sea past the viewer's shoulder with a sailor's narrowed eyes, charts clamped under one arm. The tide is turning, gulls are screaming, and he is already half-turned toward the open sea. Face: sunburnt, lean and handsome in a rough way; deep squint lines; bright restless brown eyes; dark brows; a straight nose; a half-smile that suggests secrets; stubble. The tip of his nose is peeling, and one eyebrow is bleached gold by sun. Hair: dark brown, wind-tossed, tied with a faded blue ribbon. Body: lean, rangy, restless. He stands with one hip cocked and his weight on the back foot, a sailor's stance. Clothing: a rust robe of salt-faded hemp, open at the neck, a dusk-violet outer coat; a sailor's red neck scarf. The coat's lining is red, and a brass compass hangs from a cord around his neck, tucked under the scarf. Hands and objects: under the left arm a thick roll of old yellow sea charts, curled at the ends, tied with cord; the right hand shades his brow. The charts are creased and stained with salt rings, and their edges show hand-drawn coastlines and a ring of tiny stars. Background: blurred bright sea, a mast, white gulls. Masts and rigging rise against a blue sky, and a gull hangs in the air above a stone mooring post. Light: bright cold sea light from the upper left. Qi: a faint blue-grey sea shimmer. Expression: restless, clever, evasive. He wears the look of a man who knows something you do not and enjoys it.

people.imagined: On the drill yard at dawn. He has matched his step to the person beside him without noticing, and a rank of disciples is in perfect time behind. He wants to learn if he is any good.
people.subject: The moment: standing very straight on a drill ground, he turns his head just slightly toward the viewer, a rank of disciples marching in perfect step behind him. He has stepped out of line to look at someone and the whole rank behind him has stepped out with him, perfectly in time. Face: long, lean, handsome; bronzed skin; steady grey-brown eyes; straight brows; a straight nose; a firm closed mouth; a hungry glint. There is a small mole at the left temple, and his cheekbones are very high. Hair: black, in a tight, flat topknot. Body: tall, straight-backed, long-legged. He is almost too straight, with a stiffness in the neck. Clothing: a pale ochre inner robe, rust jacket and dusk-violet outer robe of fine hemp, fastened with a wide belt; a small grey goose-feather pin at the collar. The wide belt is black leather with a plain iron buckle, and the robe's rust sleeves are cuffed in dusk-violet. Hands and objects: his right fist rests at his chest; behind him, a rank of small figures. The fist at his chest is closed over nothing, as if holding a sword hilt. Background: blurred wide dusty drill yard, a low pale dawn. The rank is ten rows of small identical figures in rust, each lifting the same foot at the same moment. Light: pale gold morning light from the upper left. Qi: a faint grey-brown earth shimmer. Expression: disciplined, ambitious, watchful. His look has the hunger of a man who has trained a long time for something that has not come.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder sitting in the grass facing west, the day he sat down and did not get up.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a thin old man sits cross-legged in grass, facing a red sunset, looking over his shoulder at the viewer. The evening sun is on his back as he sits in the grass, and a few herders have come to watch from a respectful distance. Face: thin, gaunt and lined; weathered tanned skin; kind, deep-set pale eyes; thin white brows; a long nose; a quiet smile; a thin white beard. A bony nose and a very deep line from nose to mouth; the beard is wispy and long. Hair: white, long and loose to the shoulders. Body: thin, light, relaxed. His knees are bony and his spine is perfectly straight. Clothing: grass-stained hemp robes, undyed, the colour of dry straw, plain and clean; a rope belt. The robe is stained at the hem with green, and his bare feet are visible in the grass. Hands and objects: his open hands rest on his knees, a small stalk of grass between the fingers. Background: a wide western steppe, a huge red-orange sunset, one low tree. Behind him a young maple of four leaves is planted in the grass, and beyond it the plain runs flat to a red horizon. Light: red-gold sunset light across the face. The sun lights the white hair from behind like a thin halo. Qi: a faint pale gold shimmer. Expression: peaceful, patient, generous. He looks as if he has just understood something simple.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the war elder in red-brown armour with a pale sword on her back, as in the Geese Hall's one painting.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a broad woman in armour stands facing the viewer, hand on a pale sword hilt at her shoulder. She stands in the Geese Hall as in the one painting it owns, upright, with her hand at the sword hilt. Face: broad, strong, plain; brown skin; steady wide dark eyes; thick straight brows; a wide mouth firm; a scar across the chin. A broad nose, a heavy jaw, and a short thin scar across the chin. Hair: black, tightly braided and wound at the back of the head, iron pins. Two iron pins hold the braid, and a few short hairs curl at the temples. Body: broad-shouldered, powerful, upright. Clothing: red-brown lacquered scale armour with grey felt under-coat and a dusk-violet cloak; a leather collar. The armour's scales are red-brown lacquer overlapping in rows, each rimmed with black; the cloak is dusk-violet and fastened at the throat with an iron clasp. Hands and objects: over her right shoulder the hilt of a long pale blue-white sword with a silver cord-wrapped grip, clearly visible. The sword's hilt is wrapped in silver cord, and its pommel is a plain round disc of pale steel. Background: a pale blank ground with a darker grey wash, a faint line of geese. The ground is a flat pale grey-brown with a faint V of geese drawn at the upper left. Light: soft light from the upper left. Qi: a faint pale blue frost shimmer at the sword. Expression: stern, loyal, resolved. She has the look of a woman who will do her duty whether she is thanked or not.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the first armourer at the moment he held the iron gate, anvil on his back as when he first came.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting, edges darkened; a stocky smith braces against a huge iron gate with both arms spread, glancing back. The Tùng Đào chain is cut, the iron gates are shuddering under a ram, and he has set his back to them so others can pass. Face: broad, rough and burn-scarred; thick black brows; a heavy jaw; narrow determined dark eyes; a short thick nose; a set mouth. Burn scars pit his left cheek and one eyebrow is gone. Hair: black, short and singed. The hair is singed to stubble over the left ear. Body: stocky, very broad-shouldered, thick-armed. Clothing: a rust leather smith's apron over a plain steppe hemp robe, sleeves rolled to the shoulder. The apron has a hole burned in the lower left corner and the hem of the hemp robe is charred. Hands and objects: both arms stretched against two big black iron gate leaves, hands flat; at his feet a small iron anvil. Background: a dark wall of iron bars and an orange glow of fire behind. Two huge black iron gate leaves, studded with rivets, fill the frame behind him. Light: orange firelight from behind, soft light on the face from the upper left. Orange fire throws his shadow forward and a pale ray from the upper left touches his face. Qi: a faint orange-red glow along the iron. Expression: grim, stubborn, brave. There is no fear in it, only stubbornness.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the elder at the fire of the Petal Shore, petals and ash falling together.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of a young woman standing with a drawn sword amid falling pink petals and grey ash, the orchard's blossoms and the burning ashes falling together over her in the last hour of the city. Face: a round, soft, brave face with fair skin, warm dark eyes, gentle brows, a straight small nose, a calm mouth with a faint smile, a sooty smudge on the cheek and one fine line of ash across the forehead. Hair: black, in a high knot with one peach blossom half burned at the edge. Body: slim and steady, standing with her feet apart and the sword point low, resting. Clothing: a rust robe with a dusk-violet vest and light lacquered shoulder plates of thin scuffed leather with a red cord, the hem singed by sparks and showing a pale ochre lining. Hands and objects: both hands hold a plain straight sword pointed down; pink petals and grey ash flakes lie on her shoulders. Background: a gate arch wreathed in orange flame and the dark shapes of burning orchard trees, falling pink petals. Light: orange glow from behind, soft light on her face from the upper left, fading to old-silk yellow at the edges. Qi: a faint pink-gold shimmer. Expression: brave, gentle and resolved, almost calm, as if she were tending the end of something rather than fighting it.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the fleet master on the deck of his flagship, three pennants over his head, the harbour mouth behind.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of a bold man standing on a ship's high stern with three small coloured pennants flying on a pole behind his head, just after giving the order to moor across the harbour mouth, grinning into the wind. Face: broad, bronzed and handsome, with a short black beard cut in a sharp point, bright greedy dark eyes, thick brows, an impatient grin, a nick on the nose and a pearl earring in the left ear. Hair: black, tied in a topknot with a red cloth. Body: big, strong and swaggering, his feet planted wide on a pitching deck and his chest thrust out. Clothing: a rust coat with a dusk-violet sash and a double row of round bright brass buttons, and a sea-grey cloak lined in red flapping behind him. Hands and objects: one hand on a rope, the other pointing out to sea; behind him on a pole three pennants in red, orange and violet. Background: a harbour mouth with a line of dark ships crossing it, grey sea and smoke rising from a far shore. Light: warm light from the upper left, reflected off the brass, fading to old-silk yellow at the edges. Qi: a faint blue-grey sea shimmer. Expression: a bold, impatient, grimly unafraid grin, greedy for glory and ready to meet whatever comes up the harbour.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the best singer on the last rope bridge, her stern lamp lit beside her, mouth open in song.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of a woman standing on a narrow rope bridge with a stern lamp hanging beside her, singing with her chin lifted while the ropes move under her. Face: a broad, warm, strong face with her father's wide jaw, bronzed skin, closed eyes with long lashes, thick strong black brows, a wide open mouth in song, dimples and cheeks wet with spray. Hair: black, in a thick braid pinned up with a red ribbon. Body: sturdy and upright, her feet set apart on the swaying planks and one knee bent. Clothing: a rust robe with a dusk-violet vest piped in rust, the sleeves tied back with red cord and a brass stern-lamp clasp at the collar. Hands and objects: one hand lifted holding the rope; beside her an orange stern lamp swinging from a hook. Background: a pale gorge in mist with rope railings running in perspective and the far side a faint blue cliff. Light: warm lamp light from the upper left, the orange glow on her chin and throat, fading to old-silk yellow at the edges. Qi: a faint blue-grey shimmer. Expression: joyful and calm, the mouth open in song and the face quite free of anger, an entire courage that does not need to be defended.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the steward in the city's last hour, loading archives to the boats, a string of bone rods in her hand.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened, of a calm woman who has stopped for one second to straighten a string of bone counting rods before handing over the last archive box, smoke thickening in the river air as she looks at the viewer. Face: a calm, plain, fine-boned face with olive skin, steady dark eyes, straight brows, a firm gentle mouth, a faint line between the brows and a fine line of soot across the brow. Hair: black, in a neat low coil with a wooden pin. Body: slim and upright, her elbows tucked in, neat even now. Clothing: a plain ochre robe of fine hemp under a rust outer vest edged in ochre, the sleeves tied with brown cord. Hands and objects: a string of pale bone counting rods held up, each a short white stick; at her side a stack of wooden boxes. Background: a pale river quay with a moored boat being loaded with wooden archive boxes by faint figures, a grey smear of smoke across the sky. Light: dim yellowish light from the upper left, as though through smoke, fading to old-silk yellow at the edges. Qi: a faint pale brown shimmer. Expression: calm, honest and resolved, no fear, only a steady composure with a little rueful warmth at the corner of the mouth.

people.imagined: Dusk on a river landing. He has just sat down on the boards with a handful of boat nails and is grinding them with a stone, quietly, as he has every evening since he was seven. He is aware of Lô Xướng Vãn somewhere behind him and does not turn.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a river jetty at dusk, he looks up at the viewer with a quiet, level stare, a bandolier of black needles across his chest. He has ground the twenty-fourth needle and set it in the bandolier with a small click. Face: a lean, calm, river-brown face; narrow dark eyes without a flicker; straight even brows; a straight nose; a closed mouth with no smile; a small old scar on the chin. A thin white scar from a fishhook runs along the left jaw. Hair: black, tied in a plain low tail with a strip of black cord. The black cord that ties his hair is cut from an old net. Body: lean, narrow-shouldered, sitting very still. He sits cross-legged with his back straight, absolutely still. Clothing: a pale ochre inner robe and a rust jacket of fine hemp, clean, the sleeves tight; over the shoulders a tarred black-brown boatman's coat, old but oiled and carefully kept. The boatman's coat has tar-stiffened sleeves and a big wooden toggle at the neck. Hands and objects: a leather bandolier across the chest holds twenty-four black needles in two neat rows, each a thin dull-black spike, clearly visible; his right hand rests on a small whetstone beside him. Background: blurred grey river and wooden landing posts, one lit stern lamp far off. A line of old boat posts leans in the shallows, and one nail glints on the planks near him. Light: dim red dusk light from the upper left; a faint blue-grey water shimmer of qi at the needles. Expression: calm, detached, patient, with a cold stillness. There is a coldness without cruelty, like deep water.

people.imagined: At the miasma's edge at night, one hand on the grey veil at her throat. She has just come back from walking three hundred paces into the dark, and she looks at her father's lantern with a stubborn eye.
people.subject: The moment: at night on the edge of a grey ash plain, she pulls a grey veil loose at her throat and looks at the viewer with a defiant, steady gaze, her hair cut very short. It is the third night since she came back from the three hundred paces and she has come to look at the grey again. Face: a long, strong, weathered face with high cheekbones; grey-tinged tan skin; clear dark eyes; thick straight brows; a firm mouth; faint pale burn marks along the scalp edge and one ear. The skin along the scalp line is shiny and pink with burn, and her left ear is notched. Hair: cropped very short, like a boy's, dark with a patch of scorched grey at one temple; no ornament. The cropped hair is uneven and a lock above the left ear is grey as ash. Body: tall, rangy, long-armed, rawboned. She stands with her shoulders squared and her feet planted a little too wide. Clothing: a rust robe of fine hemp with a dusk-violet jacket, the cuffs bound; a grey hemp veil, soaked in tincture, loose around the neck and hanging over the collarbone, clearly visible. The veil is grey hemp and stained brown with tincture at the edges; the jacket's cuffs are bound with grey cord. Hands and objects: the left hand tugs the veil; the right hand holds a short plain flying sword in a dark grey scabbard point-down. Background: blurred black night, a wall of grey miasma mist with a faint green lantern light far behind. The lantern of the Watch burns green far behind her like a small drowned star. Light: faint green lantern light from the left and below; a faint grey-brown shimmer of qi. Expression: stubborn, impatient, proud. She is stubborn and impatient, looking at something over the viewer's shoulder.

people.imagined: At the outer gate, in the old seat's schoolroom, chalk on his sleeves, signing a placement he has no say in. He smiles mildly while thinking of his son's name on a list.
people.subject: The moment: at the slate board in a schoolroom, he turns from the chalk with a mild, tired smile, a writing brush in his hand, having set down the pen to wipe chalk from his hands with the Placement Day list half signed and his son's name somewhere on it. Face: a soft, round, mild face with fair skin, small gentle brown eyes, thin low brows, a short nose, a small warm mouth, a double chin, slightly sticking-out ears and soft cheeks with a faint blush. Hair: thin black going grey, in a small topknot with a wood pin. Body: short, plump and slightly stooped, a small pot belly against the board. Clothing: a clean pale ochre robe of sturdy hemp with a brown cotton sash, both sleeves dusted white with chalk to the elbow. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a short stick of white chalk, fingertips white; the left holds a writing brush above a blank paper form. Background: a blurred black slate board covered with faint chalk circles and a half-erased column of sums with no letters, a sunlit window. Light: soft warm afternoon light from the upper left. Qi: a faint brown earth shimmer. Expression: a kind, tired, humble smile with worried eyes above it, a mild man trying to look calm while thinking about one name on one list.

people.imagined: Between two stalls in a market, he lets his smile arrive a beat too early. One of his three pouches is fat, one thin, one flat and empty, and he touches the empty one.
people.subject: The moment: at a busy market, he gives a quick, bright merchant's smile at the viewer while one hand touches a flat empty pouch at his belt, a bargain just closed and his eyes already seeking the next buyer. Face: a round, well-fed, rosy face with a quick wide smile, bright dark eyes with laugh lines, thick brows, a small wispy moustache, a plump chin, smooth-shaven cheeks and gold studs in his ears. Hair: black, in a glossy topknot with a gilt pin. Body: stout, broad and well fed, with a thick waist and large gestures. Clothing: a rust robe of excellent hemp over a pale ochre under-robe, a wide dusk-violet silk sash, and on the belt three cloth money pouches in red, green and grey, one full and round, one half full and one flat and empty, plainly visible. Hands and objects: the right hand rests on the flat pouch; the left holds a small bundle of coloured sample cloth. Background: blurred market stalls with awnings in red and ochre, hanging cloth in bright colours and a crowd that is a blur of hats. Light: bright warm market light from the upper left, a warm gleam on the gilt pin. Qi: a faint brown shimmer. Expression: quick, hungry and genial, the smile easy and the eyes calculating, a merchant whose goodwill is real and whose arithmetic is faster.

people.imagined: Deep in the galleries under the seat, a lamp on her forehead, dust in every crease. She has just passed the locked door again and does not look back at it.
people.subject: The moment: in a dark stone gallery she looks at the viewer with her head-lamp lit, having just stopped at a locked door and decided not to ask, and not looking back at it. Face: a small, plain, round face with a snub nose, wide at the nostril, dust-grey cheeks, small steady dark eyes, thick dust-grey brows, a small thin mouth and dust caught in every crease of the eyes and mouth. Hair: black, tied back under a broad strap across the forehead holding a small tin lamp with a steady yellow flame, clearly visible. Body: small, stout and sturdy, standing with her feet turned out like a miner. Clothing: a rust robe of fine hemp over an ochre inner robe, clean at the front but powdered with grey dust in every fold like flour, a dusk-violet sash and the sleeves tied back. Hands and objects: one hand holds a short pale knotted silver-pine pole with a small grey cloth flag; the other presses against a rough stone wall. Background: a blurred dark cut-stone gallery with timber props and, at the edge of the lamp's reach, a heavy iron-bound door with a fresh scuff of dust on its sill. Light: warm yellow head-lamp light from the front with deep shadow around; a faint silver-grey shimmer in the stone. Expression: reserved and wary, the lips pressed and the dark eyes guarded, an honest woman keeping a question to herself.

people.imagined: On a bay-festival stage at dusk, a zither half out of its bag. She has just sung a line and her mother's face in a far window comes into her mind; she holds the smile.
people.subject: The moment: on a festival stage, she lifts her chin in song and glances at the viewer with a warm smile that stops short of her eyes. A line of the Evening Song has just ended and the last note hangs, and her gaze goes to a far window where she cannot see her mother. Face: a slender, pretty, oval face; fair skin; large liquid dark eyes with shadow beneath; delicate arched brows; a small red mouth; a faint worry line. A tiny beauty mark sits under her left eye. Hair: black, long, half up with two silver combs, the rest down her back. Body: slender, graceful, long neck. She stands with her neck long and shoulders open. Clothing: a dusk-violet robe of fine hemp shading to red at the hem, with long sleeves; a pale ochre sash; a pressed red leaf pinned at the collar. The robe's hem is the red of sunset, and the sleeves are tied up with silk cords. Hands and objects: a long zither in a faded grey bag, slung from her shoulder, half out of its bag, the strings and one wooden end showing clearly. Background: blurred lanterns, bay water at dusk, a crowd. Round red paper lanterns hang in rows along the stage and the dark water of the bay shines behind. Light: warm red lantern light from the upper left; faint grey-brown shimmer. Expression: warm, falsely bright, anxious. The eyes are bright with a thin film of wet.

people.imagined: At her high desk in the Counting House, abacus clicking in her sleeve, in the middle of saying something that contradicts her superior. She has found a number that won't add up.
people.subject: The moment: mid-sentence at a high desk, she raises one eyebrow at the viewer and her sleeve clicks. A figure has not tallied and she cannot let it go. Face: a brisk, sharp, thin face; warm brown skin; quick bright eyes; straight arched brows with one lifted; a pointed chin; a mouth slightly pursed to speak; ink on the cheek. Her cheekbones are sharp and a faint line sits between the brows. Hair: black, in a tight bun pierced with a brass pin. Body: slim, quick, upright. She stands on her toes slightly at the high desk. Clothing: a rust robe of excellent hemp with a pale ochre collar; the sleeves tied back; from the right sleeve the round wooden edge of a small abacus peeks. The collar is ochre and the inner sleeves are stitched in brown. Hands and objects: the right hand lifts a brush; the left hand's fingers rest on the small abacus half out of her sleeve, clearly visible. The abacus' beads are brown wood, and her fingers are quick and ink-stained. Background: blurred tall shelves of boxes, a lamp. Tall wooden shelves of lidded boxes recede behind her, each with a tag of red thread. Light: warm lamp light from the upper left; faint brown shimmer. Expression: brisk, stubborn, impatient. She looks ready to argue and sure that she is right.

people.imagined: In the maple terraces, talking with both hands and his whole face about the move, green on his nails, completely sure.
people.subject: The moment: in the middle of an eager speech, he gestures with both hands and leans toward the viewer. He is telling the same story about the move for the hundredth time and has come to the best part. Face: a long, expressive, gangly face; light skin with an excited flush; wide bright eyes; high lifted brows; a big grin; a prominent Adam's apple. His chin is long and his big ears stick out a little. Hair: light brown, tied in a messy knot, with a leaf stuck in it. Body: gangly, tall, long arms in motion. He is all elbows and knees, and bends at the waist when he speaks. Clothing: a rust robe of fine hemp, the sleeves loose and flapping; a dusk-violet collar; a pressed red maple leaf pinned at the collar. The sleeves are very wide and flap when he gestures, the belt is a plain green cord. Hands and objects: both hands up and spread, the fingernails stained bright green, clearly visible; one hand holds a few green herb leaves. Background: blurred maple terraces, red and green leaves. Terraces of herbs climb in green steps behind him, and one maple is scarlet at the top. Light: bright golden light from the upper left; a faint green-gold shimmer. Expression: eager, arrogant, animated. He is delighted with himself and does not notice it.

people.imagined: Standing on a shingle shore. She has stopped walking and turned to face the sea, as she does whenever she stops. She is thinking of a fleet.
people.subject: The moment: standing on a shore with her face turned toward the sea, she glances over her shoulder at the viewer. The tide pulls at the shingle and she turns her back to the land again. Face: a weathered, strong face; sun-darkened skin; deep squint lines; steady grey-green eyes; straight dark brows; a firm mouth; salt on her cheek. The skin at her eyes is deeply creased and her lips are cracked by salt. Hair: dark brown with grey, in a thick braid wound around her head, wind-loosened. Body: athletic, broad-shouldered. She stands with her legs apart, hands behind her back. Clothing: a rust robe of salt-faded hemp with a dusk-violet jacket; a sea-grey cloak over one shoulder; sleeves tied back. The cloak's edge is stiff with dried salt. Hands and objects: one hand holds a rolled grey cloth; the other rests on her belt. The grey rolled cloth in her hand is tied with a cord of blue thread. Background: blurred grey sea and pale horizon, wet shingle. Fog lies low on the water and one white sail is a mere speck at the horizon. Light: cold bright sea light from the upper left; faint blue-grey shimmer. Expression: restless, brave, looking away. She looks restless as if the shore is a place she is only passing through.

people.imagined: At a table in the Boat Hall, hands closed, not singing, while the others sing. He has his grandfather's voice and uses it only to argue.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a long table with his thick fists closed, he glares at the viewer and refuses to sing. The others raise the ninth verse and he sits with his mouth shut. Face: a thick-set, square face with a heavy jaw; bronzed skin; hard dark eyes; thick black brows; a flat nose; a tight mouth with the corners down; a short black beard. The beard grows low on his cheeks, and his eyes are slightly bloodshot. Hair: black, in a tight high knot. Body: thickset, broad, with heavy shoulders. He sits with shoulders hunched and elbows on the table. Clothing: a rust robe of strong hemp with a dusk-violet jacket, sleeves rolled; a brass stern-lamp clasp at the collar. The jacket's collar is open and the robe has a wine-coloured stain at the cuff. Hands and objects: both big fists closed on the table; behind him on the wall a hanging stern lamp, unlit. Background: blurred wooden hall, boat oars hung on the wall. Oars hang along a wooden wall and a row of unlit stern lamps hangs above. Light: dim warm light from the upper left; faint blue-grey shimmer. Lamplight falls on the left side of his face, leaving the other in shadow. Expression: bitter, vengeful, withdrawn. He looks bitter and proud.

people.imagined: On the drill ground at first light, rasping a command, unable to slouch. He has drawn a bean from his pocket and is looking at the left file.
people.subject: The moment: standing rigid on a drill ground at dawn, mouth open in a rasping shout, one hand holding up a small bean. It is the first light and he has just drawn the black bean again from the left file. Face: a lean, hard, red-brown face; a clipped grey moustache; narrow stern eyes; heavy straight brows; a hawk nose; a taut mouth. His moustache is clipped square and his lower lip protrudes. Hair: grey-black, cropped short. Body: tall, stiff, ramrod straight. His neck is stiff and chin lifted, like a man on parade. Clothing: a rust jacket and dusk-violet robe of fine hemp, tightly belted, the collar buttoned to the chin; a small grey goose-feather pin at the collar. The belt buckle is polished, and the grey goose pin is crooked by a hair. Hands and objects: the right hand holds up between finger and thumb a small black bean; the left fist is clenched at his hip. Background: blurred dusty drill ground, lines of small figures, a pale dawn. A line of rust-coloured figures stands in a dusty plain, the leftmost three in bowed postures. Light: cool gold dawn light from the upper left; faint grey-brown shimmer. Expression: harsh, rigid, arbitrary. He is harsh, yet there is no pleasure in it.

people.imagined: Conducting the inner choir in summer with a red scarf at her neck, her long arms conducting even when she means them to be still. She is thinking of the missing tune.
people.subject: The moment: in mid-conducting, both long arms lifted, she smiles broadly and turns her head toward the viewer; the choir is on the high note and she is conducting without knowing it, her mind on the missing tune. Face: a broad, warm, freckled face with light brown eyes, thick expressive brows, a wide expressive mouth open in song and flushed cheeks. Hair: chestnut, in a high bun held by a bone comb with three teeth missing, short curls springing loose at the nape. Body: tall, with unusually long arms, the sleeves riding up. Clothing: a rust robe of fine hemp with a dusk-violet jacket, the sleeves cut wide so the arms swing free, a stern-lamp clasp, and around her neck a bright cherry-red wool scarf, thick and loosely knotted twice at the throat with the ends hanging, clearly visible. Hands and objects: both arms raised and spread as if conducting, fingers curled. Background: pillars of dark wood and three rows of singers in rust robes, blurred. Light: warm light from the upper left, a shaft from a high window crossing the front row of singers and catching her cheekbone and the red of the scarf. Qi: a faint brown-grey shimmer. Expression: joyous and warm, the mouth open and the cheeks bright, with an edge of worry in the lifted brows, a stubborn devout woman who will not stop conducting until the tune comes back.

people.imagined: At the edge of the grey, smelling of lime, plaiting his beard. He has just lost another man to the miasma and is not saying so.
people.subject: The moment: standing at the miasma's edge, he looks past the viewer toward the grey with a stone face, a lantern just refilled at his belt, thinking of forty graves and having just lost another man, not saying so. Face (most important: a long grey beard plaited into several braids whitened with lime dust): a grim, heavy, weather-beaten face with ash-pale skin, deep-set small eyes, heavy grey brows, a big nose broken twice, and lime dust in the creases beside the eyes. Hair: grey, cropped short and whitened with lime, the beard plaits tied off with scraps of grey cloth. Body: heavy, broad, solid and slow, with a slight sag in the knees from standing a long time. Clothing: a heavy grey felt coat over earth-iron scale and an ash-grey robe, with a dusk-violet collar edge, all of good cloth gone grey with dust. Hands and objects: one thick hand grips a spade with white lime on its blade; a small lantern with a pale green flame hangs from the belt. Background: a blurred grey ash plain and mist, a small row of earth mounds each with a stick along the edge of the ash, and a raw mound of fresh earth. Light: pale grey-green light from the left. Qi: a faint heavy brown shimmer. Expression: a hard, loyal weariness, the jaw set and the eyes dull, not hard in himself but worn down to stone.

people.imagined: At the Counting House desk. A certain abacus clicks across the room and his ears go red. He rounds the next sum up and tells himself it is for her.
people.subject: The moment: looking up from a desk at a sound out of frame, ears bright red, he turns a half-embarrassed look on the viewer. The abacus clicks across the room and his ears turn red before he looks up. Face: a thin, earnest, youthful face; pale skin; a flush across the cheeks; big nervous brown eyes; thin brows; a small mouth; two very red ears, clearly visible. His eyelashes are long and his chin is weak. Hair: black, in a tidy topknot, ears fully uncovered. Body: thin and narrow, shoulders slightly hunched. He sits hunched over the desk, with his elbows pulled in. Clothing: a pale ochre robe and rust jacket of fine hemp, sleeves tied back, ink on the cuffs. His collar is neatly pinned and the cuffs are inked. Hands and objects: one hand holds a brush above a blank page; the other rests on a small abacus with bone beads. Background: blurred shelves of boxes and a lamp. Rows of lidded boxes behind him and a window with a square of bright sky. Light: warm lamp light from the upper left; faint brown shimmer. The lamp lights his ears pink. Expression: shy, flustered, secretly calculating. He looks like he is about to apologise to the air.

people.imagined: On the bow of a toll boat at the river mouth, squinting sidelong at a barge as a heron squints at a fish, counting.
people.subject: The moment: standing in the bow of a toll boat at the river mouth, she squints sidelong at the viewer the way a heron squints at a fish, silently counting the sacks of a passing barge. Face: a narrow, sharp, tanned face with a long nose, narrow sidelong dark eyes, thin straight brows, a small pursed mouth, faint wind lines, a long neck and a pointed chin. Hair: black, in a tight bun with a blue head-cloth knotted over it at the nape. Body: lean, long-necked and narrow-shouldered, standing one-legged for a moment like a heron. Clothing: a rust robe of strong hemp with a dusk-violet jacket and a sea-grey short cloak fastened with a brass pin, the sleeves tied back. Hands and objects: both hands hold a long punting pole; at her belt a small leather pouch with coin shapes pushing out its sides. Background: a blurred wide river mouth of grey water with a heavily laden barge sliding across it under a square sail. Light: cold bright river light from the upper left. Qi: a faint blue-grey shimmer. Expression: cool and calculating, the eyes narrowed to slits and the small mouth pursed, watchful and betraying nothing, her greed hidden behind perfect patience.

people.imagined: On a steppe road beside a wagon, a tarnished whistle at his throat that he blows to end arguments. He is padding a bill in his head.
people.subject: The moment: beside a laden wagon on a steppe road, he holds the tarnished whistle between his lips and gives the viewer a jovial look. The argument at the wagon is rising and his whistle is already at his lips. Face: a ruddy, broad, windburnt face; a big grin; small bright dark eyes; thick brows; a broken nose; stubble. His cheeks are cracked red with wind, and a gold tooth shows at the side of his grin. Hair: black going grey, in a tight knot with a leather cord. Body: thick, strong, a bit paunchy. His legs are bowed from years in the saddle. Clothing: a rust robe of sturdy hemp with a dusk-violet coat, dust to the knee; a tarnished silver whistle on a cord at the throat, clearly visible. The coat has a fur collar greyed by dust, and the boots are caked with yellow clay. Hands and objects: one hand holds the whistle; the other holds a stack of tally sticks. Background: blurred yellow steppe grass, a laden cart and oxen. Behind him a line of heavy wagons and patient oxen stretches along a pale yellow road. Light: bright hard light from the upper left; faint brown shimmer. Expression: jovial, shrewd, greedy. He is jolly but his eyes move constantly across the viewer's purse.

people.imagined: On the road with a letter case, she has just resealed a letter and slid her hand into the secret pocket of her cloak, a pleasant smile in place.
people.subject: The moment: on a road, she slips a letter into a pocket sewn inside her cloak and smiles pleasantly at the viewer. She is on the road between two vassals and has just broken a seal and closed it again with a warm thumb. Face: a smooth, pretty, fair face; soft cheeks; clever light-brown eyes; fine arched brows; a small sweet smile; a mole by the nose. Her brows are shaped fine, and her ears are small and pink. Hair: glossy black, in a neat low coil with a jade pin. Body: slender, graceful. She walks with small, even steps. Clothing: a rust robe of fine hemp; over it a dusk-violet travel cloak, its inner lining showing a hidden pocket opened at the breast, clearly visible. The travel cloak is dusk-violet lined with grey; the collar is edged with fur. Hands and objects: soft, clean, unscarred clerk's hands, one sliding a folded paper into the pocket. The pocket's inner lining is pale grey, with the corner of a letter showing. Background: blurred road, a distant gate, soft grey sky. A road runs pale through a green plain towards a small gate. Light: soft light from the upper left; faint brown shimmer. Expression: sweet, deceptive, calm. There is no sign of her thoughts.

people.imagined: Beside a steppe pond with a boat, the empty left sleeve pinned across his chest, teaching a boy to row one-handed. He is patient.
people.subject: The moment: seated in a small boat on a steppe pond, he demonstrates a stroke with his one arm and looks at the viewer with a kindly steady gaze, a boy having just caught the stroke right and him nodding slowly, his empty left sleeve pinned flat across his chest. Face: a broad, weathered, kind face with deep smile lines, steady brown eyes, thick brows, grey stubble, a calm mouth and a scar running from the left ear down the neck. Hair: grey-black, in a plain topknot. Body: broad-chested and powerful on the right side, the left shoulder lower and the right arm thick as a post. Clothing: a rust robe with a dusk-violet jacket, the left sleeve empty and folded flat across the chest, pinned with a brass pin shaped like a small oar, clearly visible. Hands and objects: the right hand grips a long oar, the knuckles strong. Background: a blurred grassy pond bank with reed beds ringing a still pond, a grey boat tilting at a jetty, and a pale sky. Light: soft light from the upper left. Qi: a faint blue-grey shimmer. Expression: patient, calm and forgiving, with humour in the lines at the corners of his eyes, the face of a man who has lost an arm and kept the rest of himself.

people.imagined: In the gallery lamplight tending a silver-pine prop; the lamp catches silver flecks in her eyelashes, and she blinks them slowly.
people.subject: The moment: beside a pillar of silver-pine in lamplight, she blinks slowly at the viewer, silver flecks glittering on her lashes. She has stopped between two props to rest a hand on the silver-pine and a mote of silver lands on her cheek. Face: a calm, thin, quiet face; pale skin; grey-green eyes; the eyelashes bright with tiny silver flecks, clearly visible; straight light brows; a small mouth. A tiny scar crosses her upper lip. Hair: light brown, in a low knot with a wood pin. The low knot is held by a plain wood pin and a pale silver speck sits on one strand beside her ear. Body: slim, small, gentle. She stands with her head slightly bowed. Clothing: a rust robe of fine hemp, with a dusk-violet sash; sleeves tied back; silver dust on the cuffs. The robe's cuffs are silver-dusted and the sash is a plain brown. Hands and objects: one hand rests on a pale silver-grey pine pole; the other holds a small brush. A small pot of pine pitch stands on the floor at her feet, and a thin brown thread of cord is looped round her wrist. Background: blurred dark gallery, timber props, lamp glow. A forest of pale pine props rises in a gallery, each with a small hanging lamp. Light: warm lamp light from the upper left; faint silver-white shimmer. The lamp throws a soft amber circle; where it touches the pine pole the bark gleams like wet metal. Expression: quiet, patient, reserved. She is quiet and gentle.

people.imagined: At a quay stall selling a printed chart of a star. She glances up at a ledge as she did as a nest-picker and sells the sky for a third boat.
people.subject: The moment: at a quay stall holding up a chart, she glances up at a roof ledge, then at the viewer. A buyer has stopped at the stall and she holds up the chart for him to see. Face: a narrow, sun-brown face; a long nose; wide watchful hazel eyes; thin brows; a small smile; quick head tilt. Her ears are small and one earlobe is pierced with a tiny bone ring. Hair: black, in a high braid with a green string. Body: slim, light, quick. She stands lightly on her toes. Clothing: a rust robe of salt-faded hemp, a dusk-violet vest, a sea-grey scarf. The scarf is knotted at the side and fringed with grey wool. Hands and objects: both hands hold up a large paper sea-chart marked with a ring of small printed stars and no writing; a roll of charts at her belt. The chart is covered with a ring of tiny printed stars, one circled in red. Background: blurred quay, boats and masts, a pale sea. Gulls wheel above a row of tall masts and a salt-streaked quay. Light: bright sea light from the upper left; faint blue-grey shimmer. Expression: watchful, honest, quick. She looks quick and honest.

people.imagined: At the doorway of the Hall of Scales, filling it. The children say he is a door that walks. He does not look away.
people.subject: The moment: standing square in a high doorway so that he fills it, arms at his sides, looking straight at the viewer without moving, a small girl led before the Hall of Scales and him not looking away from the sentence; the children say he is a door that walks. Face: a huge, flat, expressionless face with a square jaw, pale scarred skin, a thin scar across the left cheekbone, calm black eyes that never move, thick straight brows and a mouth like a slot. Hair: black, cropped very short. Body: enormous, very tall and very broad, like a door, his shoulders nearly touching both sides of the frame. Clothing: a dusk-violet robe of fine hemp pressed without a single crease, a rust sash knotted exactly in the centre. Hands and objects: one huge hand grips a plain dark wooden staff of office with a black iron cap, as tall as himself; the other hangs open. Background: a tall dark wooden doorframe with a pale hall beyond it. Light: cool light from the upper left. Qi: a faint grey-brown shimmer. Expression: blank, just and immovable, the black eyes level and the mouth a straight slot, untroubled, a man to whom a sentence is only a sentence.

people.imagined: On the herb terraces. A pleasant smile arrives a moment before the thing it is for. She holds a bunch of leaves with a mark she should not have.
people.subject: The moment: on a terrace, she gives the viewer a smile that arrives a moment too early and is held too long, selling leaves with a false mark. Face: a round, soft, pleasant face with rosy cheeks, warm brown eyes with a cool flicker in them, arched brows, a wide smile, a small dimple and faint crow's feet. Hair: brown, in a neat bun with a red leaf pinned in it. Body: plump, comfortable and relaxed, one hip against a terrace wall. Her weight rests on one hip and her free hand hangs loose, the picture of a woman at ease in her own terrace, with the soft rounded shoulders of someone who has never hurried a day of her life. Clothing: a rust robe of fine hemp with a dusk-violet vest, the sleeves rolled, and a pressed red maple leaf, almost black-red, at the collar. Hands and objects: both hands hold a bundle of green leaves tied with red thread, with a small round painted mark on the tie. Background: blurred green herb terraces climbing behind her to a red maple at the top. Light: warm light from the upper left. Qi: a faint green-gold shimmer. Expression: a pleasant, kind smile with the eyes sliding sideways to check whether it has worked, the practised charm of a woman whose luck has never quite matched her care.

people.imagined: On a rope bridge with a coil of rope over his shoulder. The rope-sellers say a bridge could fall on that face and not improve it. He pays a boy to carry his bids.
people.subject: The moment: on a rope bridge, he turns with a heavy self-conscious frown, a coil of rope on his shoulder. A ferry girl has looked away from his face as he passes, and he ties a knot he does not need. Face: a very homely face: a lumpy, crooked nose; asymmetric small eyes; a large drooping lower lip; a heavy jaw with a wen on it; thick untidy brows; sallow skin with pockmarks. A purple birthmark covers his left cheek and the left ear is cauliflowered. Hair: coarse black, cropped short. Body: stout, short-legged, broad. His arms are very long for his body and his legs short. Clothing: a rust robe of strong hemp with a pale ochre under-robe, a leather apron; sleeves rolled. The apron is oiled leather with rope fibres stuck to it. Hands and objects: a heavy coil of brown hemp rope over one shoulder; both hands, thick and rope-burnt, hold the rope. Background: blurred rope bridge railings over a misty gorge. A rope bridge sways in mist and the gorge below is white with fog. Light: bright light from the upper left; faint brown shimmer. Expression: self-conscious, kind, plain. He appears used to being avoided and kind in spite of it.

people.imagined: In the empty halls of the old seat, oiling a maple stump by the light of the window, a moth-eaten sleeve trailing.
people.subject: The moment: in an empty hall in autumn, he kneels beside a cut maple stump with an oil cloth and glances up at the viewer, oiling the last stump for the thirtieth time by the light of the window. Face: a thin, dry, weathered face with pale skin, deep lines, patient faded brown eyes, sparse grey brows, a thin mouth, a long jaw and a small mole on the chin; a faint smell of camellia oil clings to him. Hair: fine grey hair, wispy and sparse, pulled into a small knot at the crown with a plain wooden pin. Body: lean, long and bent at the back, kneeling with great care, one hand on his knee. Clothing: a clean pale ochre robe of fine hemp with a rust sash, the cloth old, soft and carefully kept. Hands and objects: one hand holds a cloth shining with camellia oil; the other rests on a pale maple stump whose rings are dark and glossy with oil. Background: a long empty hall with pale dusty floors, tall silent pillars and motes turning in a sunbeam. Light: a pale sunbeam from the upper left. Qi: a faint green-gold shimmer. Expression: a peaceful, stubborn patience, the eyes soft and the thin mouth at rest, a loyal man content to keep a dead tree polished for a house that will not come back.

people.imagined: In the guest house on the Cloud Bridge, bringing tea so softly that the buyer starts. She says the last buyer paid more.
people.subject: The moment: holding out a cup of tea in the guest house, she has just spoken and the viewer starts; she smiles gently. The buyer has started and she has already said the other buyer paid more. Face: a soft, pale, pretty face; round gentle eyes; fine brows; a gentle small smile; a faint knowing look. Her eyes are slightly slanted and her lashes long. A faint dimple sits at the corner of her mouth, and her skin is powdered a little too pale. Hair: black, in a smooth low coil with a silver pin. A single strand of black pearls is wound once through the coil beside the silver pin. Body: slender, graceful, slow moving. She glides rather than walks. Clothing: a pale ochre robe of fine hemp with a rust over-robe and a dusk-violet sash; soft felt slippers. The slippers are grey felt and make no sound. Hands and objects: both hands hold out a small tea tray with one cup of steaming tea. The cup is thin white porcelain with a hairline gold rim, steam curling from it, and the tray is lacquered red with a small chip at one corner. Background: blurred guest room with a window onto a misty gorge. A window of the guest house frames a misty gorge and a rope bridge. Light: soft light from the upper left; faint brown shimmer. Soft grey window light from the left, a pale glow on the porcelain. Expression: gentle, soft-spoken, artful. She is soft-spoken, and artful.

people.imagined: At a ranch gate collecting late tribute, a ledger-case chained to his wrist. He says nothing until the figures agree.
people.subject: The moment: at a gate, he holds up his chained wrist with the ledger-case and gives the viewer a flat cold stare. He has been thrown off the ranch twice and stands at the gate once more. Face: a hard, narrow, pale face; a thin cruel mouth; flat grey eyes; thin straight brows; a sharp nose; a hollow cheek. His cheek is hollow and a cold sore marks his lip. Hair: black, cropped short. His cropped hair is cut so close the skin shows grey through it, and a small scar parts it above the right ear. Body: lean, tall, rigid. He holds himself like a drawn bowstring. Clothing: a dusk-violet robe of fine hemp, a dark rust sash, a grey felt collar. The dark rust sash is knotted tightly and the collar is stiff. The grey felt collar is buttoned to the throat with three bone toggles, and the robe has no ornament of any kind. Hands and objects: on the left wrist a thin chain fastened to a flat black leather case the size of a book, clearly visible; the right hand rests on the case. The chain is steel with square links and the case is dark leather edged in iron. Background: blurred wooden ranch gate, steppe, pale sky. A wooden gate with a ranch brand, and yellow steppe grass behind. Light: cold light from the upper left; faint grey-brown shimmer. Flat cold light from the upper left, no warmth in it, leaves the side of his face in even shadow. Expression: cold, cruel, stubborn. He is cold without any change.

people.imagined: Squatting at the edge of a flooded rice paddy, talking to a seedling as if it were a person, mud on his knees.
people.subject: The moment: squatting at the edge of a flooded rice paddy, he glances up from speaking to a seedling and smiles at the viewer, telling it that it will be all right, mud on his knees. Face: a round, tanned, honest face with kind dark eyes, thick brows, a wide easy smile, a smear of mud on the cheek and mud streaking one ear. Hair: black, tied in a rough knot with a leaf of last year's rice straw stuck in it, short hairs standing up at the crown. Body: sturdy, short and square, squatting with his knees wide and forearms on thighs. Clothing: a rust robe of strong hemp with the hem tied up and the sleeves rolled, a faded dusk-violet vest, muddy to the knee. Hands and objects: both hands cup a single young rice seedling, bright green, its roots wrapped in dark wet mud between his palms and three pale green leaves trembling. Background: blurred flooded paddies with green rows, silver water carrying the reflection of a pale sky. Light: bright morning light from the upper left, the flooded paddies throwing white sky back up under his chin. Qi: a faint green-gold shimmer. Expression: a gentle, content smile that suits the seedling, the eyes soft and unhurried, an honest man to whom rice is a kind of person.

people.imagined: At the edge of the miasma with a map, coughing dryly into a sleeve. One cheek is burnt dark. She has measured forty paces more.
people.subject: The moment: at the miasma's edge, she turns from a map with a dry cough into one sleeve and then looks at the viewer, having coughed twice and written another mark on the map after measuring forty paces more. Face (most important: the left cheek burnt dark brown-black in a large patch, glossy like polished walnut): a thin, sunken, grey-tanned face with small tired dark eyes, thin brows and a thin mouth. Hair: black, in a low knot under a grey cotton scarf stained brown at the edge. Body: thin, bent a little and tense, her shoulders curled inward. Clothing: a grey felt coat over a rust robe with a dusk-violet collar, the felt soaked in tincture, and a grey veil at the neck. Hands and objects: one hand holds up a hand-drawn map on yellow paper with a ring of small black dots and no writing; the other covers her mouth. Background: a blurred bank of grey miasma mist hiding the ash plain, a faint green lantern light. Light: pale green-grey light from the left. Qi: a faint grey-brown shimmer. Expression: a tired, steady, cautious resolve, the eyes dull and the mouth thin, a woman who will keep drawing the line however much it costs her to breathe.

people.imagined: Asleep in the butt-store half an hour after dawn; woken, he lifts a bow, one shoulder higher than the other, and yawns.
people.subject: The moment: in a store room half an hour after dawn, woken from sleep, he lifts a bow and yawns widely, bleary and good-natured, testing the string with the ball of his thumb. Face: a long, lazy, tanned face with sleepy half-closed eyes, calm brows, a long nose, a mouth open mid-yawn and a day's growth of grey stubble. Hair: black going grey, in a loose knot with strands escaped and one grey lock hanging over the left ear. Body: tall, with the right shoulder drawn clearly a hand higher than the left, visible in the silhouette. Clothing: a slightly crumpled rust jacket over a dusk-violet robe of fine hemp, a grey goose-feather pin at the collar and a leather arm guard cracked and polished with use. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a long horn bow upright, the waxed yellow-brown bowstring under his thumb; a quiver with three grey goose-fletched arrows leans beside him. Background: a blurred dim store with straw archery butts stacked to the roof and stray feathers. Light: soft dim light from the upper left, a narrow dusty beam from a gap in the roof across his chest and the bow. Qi: a faint grey-brown shimmer. Expression: lazy, peaceable and calm, the yawn stretching the whole face and not a trace of embarrassment, a man at ease with being half asleep.

people.imagined: At the old seat's outer gate, laughing at a joke told a minute ago, long after everyone else has stopped.
people.subject: The moment: in the old courtyard, he bursts out laughing late at a joke told a minute ago, his head thrown back, then looks at the viewer with a broad, delay-eyed grin. Face: a big, broad, slow face with tanned skin, wide round eyes crinkled with laughter, thick grey brows, a wide red-tinged nose, a wide laughing mouth, a double chin and deep laugh lines. Hair: grey-black, in a plain knot slightly undone with a short stray grey hair standing on top. Body: large, heavy and comfortable, his belly shaking as he laughs. Clothing: a clean pale ochre robe of fine hemp with a rust sash, chalk on the cuffs. Hands and objects: one hand slaps his knee, leaving a white chalk mark on the dark cloth; the other holds a rolled letter tied with a bit of red thread, its seal unbroken. Background: a courtyard of pale stones with the grey stumps of maples beyond. Light: warm morning sun low from the left, lighting one side of his round face and making the stone yard glow. Qi: a faint brown shimmer. Expression: slow, content delight, the eyes streaming and the mouth wide, a stubborn good nature that gets there last and enjoys it most.

people.imagined: At a market talisman contest, quick hands flying, ink on her fingertips. A red jasper seal on a cord bounces at her wrist as she finishes a sheet before the others have begun.
people.subject: The moment: at a contest table she lifts a finished sheet of blank-faced talisman paper with a bright quick grin at the viewer, a red stone seal swinging on a cord at her wrist. The sheet is done before the other contestants have wetted their brushes, and the crowd's murmur has just started. Face: a small, quick, sharp young face; light golden skin; bright dark eyes full of energy; slim arched brows; a small nose; a wide eager smile; ink on the cheek. Her ears are small and pink, and a tiny dimple shows in the left cheek. Hair: black, in two high buns tied with red thread. Each bun is bound with three turns of red thread and a loose wisp falls over her left ear. Body: small, light, quick, always in motion. She is on tiptoe, leaning over the table. Clothing: an inner-gate rust robe of fine hemp with a dusk-violet collar, sleeves tied back. The jacket is cut short and the sleeves are tied up with red cord, ink-spattered at the cuffs. Hands and objects: ink-black fingertips on both hands; on the right wrist a square red jasper seal, the size of a thumb, on a thin cord, clearly visible; the left hand holds up the paper with a few loose grey swirls and no characters. Background: blurred market stalls, a crowd, red awnings. Red awnings flutter above rows of contest tables and a crowd of onlookers is a blur of hats. Light: bright warm light from the upper left; faint brown-green shimmer. Expression: brave, bright, forgiving, delighted. Bright, brave and entirely without malice, as if the win is a pleasant surprise.

people.imagined: Training alone at dusk on the outer-gate ground until sent to bed, with a small child's shoe tied at her belt. She wipes her face and keeps going.
