people.subject: The moment: in the dusk on a bare practice ground, she lowers a wooden practice spear and stares hard at the viewer, breathing hard, the steward's bell for bed not yet rung and the straw dummy still waiting for one more attack, a small child's shoe tied at her belt. Face: a thin, sunburnt, sharp face with high cheekbones, fierce dark red-rimmed eyes, thick straight brows, a set mouth, a peeling nose and a faint white line of old scab on the lower lip. Hair: black, in a rough high ponytail tied with a strip cut from a child's blue sash. Body: thin and wiry with squared shoulders, sharp elbows and scabbed knees under the rolled hem. Clothing: a clean outer-gate pale ochre robe of sturdy hemp with the sleeves tied back with cords and the collar and back darkened with sweat. Hands and objects: both hands grip a wooden practice spear; tied at her belt by its worn lace, one tiny brown scuffed child's shoe, the left of a pair, clearly visible. Background: a blurred dusty practice yard, a line of straw dummies leaning in the dust, a row of lit lamps at the far gate and a dim red sunset. Light: low red dusk light from the upper left. Qi: a faint grey-brown shimmer. Expression: fierce, red-eyed and dry, the mouth set and the stare absolutely fixed, grief turned into discipline.

people.imagined: In a courtyard, a courteous bow in an old-fashioned clan robe with swallows at the hem. He is calm and he has made up his mind about where he will not go.
people.subject: The moment: giving a polished courteous half-bow in a courtyard, he looks up calmly at the viewer. A senior has passed in the courtyard and he gives the bow he has practised. Face: a smooth, fine-featured, courteous face; fair skin; calm clear dark eyes; thin elegant brows; a straight nose; a gentle polite smile; a faint hidden stiffness. A faint blush touches his cheekbones and his jaw is delicate. Hair: black, in a neat tall knot with a plain jade pin. One thin braid of hair falls on his left shoulder. Body: slim, tall, very upright. He holds his arms exactly level, with his spine perfectly vertical. Clothing: an old-fashioned clan robe of pale blue-grey cloth with long wide sleeves, a high collar; along the hem a row of small embroidered swallows in dark blue thread, clearly visible; a pale ochre outer-gate vest. The swallows at the hem are six, each with forked tails, stitched in dark blue silk; the sleeves are lined in pale grey. Hands and objects: both hands clasped in a bow at his chest, the sleeves hanging. Background: blurred old courtyard with maples. Maple trees in the courtyard drop a few orange leaves on grey flagstones. Light: soft light from the upper left; faint green-brown shimmer. Expression: courteous, calm, quietly evasive. His politeness is complete and hides an absolute refusal.

people.imagined: Lying propped on an ore cart, bored of being asked about his sister, chewing a straw, in no hurry for anything.
people.subject: The moment: slouched against an ore cart, chewing a straw, he looks lazily at the viewer. A passer-by has asked whose brother he is and he takes the straw out of his mouth to sigh. Face: a broad, easy, round face with a wide high forehead; light brown skin; heavy-lidded relaxed eyes; thick brows; a lazy half-smile. His forehead is high and broad, like his sister's, and his chin is round and soft. Hair: black, tied in a loose knot, a strand falling. A rough black knot sits crooked on the crown, secured with a wooden pin that is not quite straight. Body: sturdy, loose, slouching. His belly is soft and his shoulders slope. Clothing: a pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp, loosened at the collar, sleeves rolled. The robe's cuffs are unrolled and the belt is tied in a lazy bow. Hands and objects: one hand holds a long straw in his teeth; the other rests on the rim of a wooden ore cart. The straw is yellow and chewed flat at the end; one palm is held open as if to say it is not his doing. Background: blurred market yard with sacks and carts. Sacks of ore are piled in a market yard, and a donkey stands asleep. Light: bright easy light from the upper left; faint brown shimmer. The light falls warm and flat across his face. Warm bright light from the upper left lays a long shadow of the cart across the dusty ground. Expression: lazy, friendly, unhurried. He shows complete good-humoured disinterest.

people.imagined: Lifting a robe out of the founder's madder dye pot, red to both elbows, patient. Steam and a dusk sky behind her.
people.subject: The moment: at a big copper dye pot, she lifts out a dripping dusk-coloured robe with both arms and smiles gently at the viewer. A cloud of steam parts as she lifts the robe, and its colour runs from violet to flame in the light. Face: a plump, kind, lined face; warm brown eyes; soft thin brows; a gentle content smile; red spatters on one cheek. Fine lines fan from her eyes and a red fleck sits on the left eyebrow. Hair: grey-black, covered in a red-stained head cloth. Body: short, round, strong in the arms. Her shoulders are broad from lifting wet cloth and her back is straight. Clothing: a plain apron over a rust-coloured robe of good hemp, the sleeves pushed above the elbows. The apron is canvas stained in every shade from rose to maroon, and the sleeves are pushed above the elbow with a wet cord. Hands and objects: both forearms are stained deep madder-red from fingertip to elbow, clearly visible; the dripping robe in her hands shades from violet to red-orange. Background: blurred steaming copper vats, hanging dyed cloth lines. Hanging cloths in red, orange and violet drip in lines behind a huge copper pot. Light: warm light from the upper left; steam glowing red-gold. Expression: patient, content, generous. She seems at peace with her work.

people.imagined: In oversized Watch plate hanging off his shoulders, standing on tiptoe to look as tall as his father. He is not allowed near the Watch.
people.subject: The moment: on tiptoe in a suit of plate far too large for him, he lifts his chin at the viewer with fierce pride, having stretched higher on his toes as his father went by, though he is not allowed near the Watch. Face: a small, thin, pale face with large earnest dark eyes, thick straight brows, a pinched jaw, a very small chin, a trembling brave mouth and ears that stick out beneath the helmet's rim. Hair: black, in a tiny topknot. Body: slight and slim, dwarfed by the armour, with his heels lifted off the floor and his neck stretched. Clothing: grey felt-and-earth-iron plate hanging far too big from his shoulders, the pauldrons past his elbows, the breastplate's lower edge reaching his knees, the straps knotted twice, the sleeves covering his hands and the collar up to his ears, over a pale ochre robe. Hands and objects: both hands hidden inside the long iron cuffs, holding a spear twice his height whose tip wobbles. Background: the blurred grey wall of the Watch house with a lantern hook and a small ladder. Light: pale grey light from the upper left. Qi: a faint brown shimmer. Expression: a fierce, trembling pride with a dread of being sent away underneath it, the lip held firm and the eyes very bright.

people.imagined: Behind a market stall on a rest day with her bead bracelet clicking. She has just told a small lie and listens to her own bracelet.
people.subject: The moment: behind a small stall, she tells a customer a smooth little lie with a sweet look at the viewer; her wrist bracelet clicks. A customer asks the price and the lie comes smooth. Face: a pretty, round, lively face; light brown skin; bright quick eyes; arched brows; a small sweet pout; a gap-toothed smile. There are two small dimples, and her nose is a little upturned. Hair: black, in two high bunches tied with orange cord. Body: small, quick, bouncy. She leans over the counter on both elbows. Clothing: a pale ochre outer-gate robe of fine hemp, a bright orange sash; sleeves rolled. The sash is tied in a double bow and the sleeve cuffs are turned back twice. Hands and objects: on her right wrist a bracelet of many small wooden abacus beads in rows, clearly visible; her left hand holds up a handful of loose beads over a cloth. Background: blurred market stall, hanging beads, awnings. Strings of loose wooden beads hang in the stall like curtains. Light: bright light from the upper left; faint brown shimmer. A bright beam through the awning lights the beads. Expression: sweet, greedy, fickle. She is all sweetness, with a flicker of fear when the bracelet clicks.

people.imagined: Leaning in toward a sunny wall as if it might hand her something. Hope on her face for the new seat's Wood.
people.subject: The moment: leaning her whole body toward a sun-bright wall, eyes closed, then opening them to smile hopefully at the viewer, as a patch of sun has reached the wall at last and she steps into it, hoping the new seat will give her Wood. Face: a long, gentle, freckled face with light green-brown eyes, high lifted pale brows, a long nose, a hopeful smile and a gangly neck. Hair: brown, loose and flyaway, with a leaf from last year still caught in it. Body: tall, lanky and a little bent forward, with bony shoulders and thin arms, so thin that the robe hangs like washing on a pole. Clothing: a clean pale ochre outer-gate robe of fine hemp with loose sleeves and green dye at the cuffs, and a sprout of wood-fern tucked in the collar with its stem soaked in water. Hands and objects: both hands rest flat against a warm yellow wall. Background: a blurred yellow plaster wall with a window and the moving shadow of a maple's lower branches. Light: bright warm light from the upper left, the plaster wall throwing warm yellow back onto her face and the leaf shadows moving on her cheek. Qi: a faint green shimmer. Expression: hopeful to the point of ache, the eyes wide and the smile unguarded, a humble, trusting girl asking the wall for one small gift.

people.imagined: In the steppe plot at dawn, transplanting a spirit-rice seedling, one thumb bent for life. She looks up as her brother's name is mentioned.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling in a wet field transplanting a seedling, she looks up with a mild smile, one thumb sharply bent. Her brother's name has just come up at the other end of the plot. Face: a round, freckled, mild face; tanned skin; honest brown eyes; thick brows; a soft smile; a mud dab on the cheek. Her cheeks are plump and her eyebrows are light brown. Hair: brown, in a thick plait over one shoulder. The plait ends in a green cord. Body: sturdy, compact. She kneels with her skirts bunched up. Clothing: a pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp, hem tied up, muddy at the knees; a straw hat hung at her back. The straw hat is flat, tied with a cotton string, and hangs on her back. Hands and objects: the right thumb is bent sideways at a permanent angle, plainly visible, holding a small bright green rice seedling. Background: blurred flooded plot, green rows, grey dawn. Rows of bright green rice seedlings reach to a pale horizon. Light: soft cool dawn light from the upper left; faint green-gold shimmer. Light is soft and low. Expression: mild, content, peaceable. She is mild and easy, and ready to follow.

people.imagined: Laughing before the joke has even arrived, rowing the lighter side while his one-handed uncle pulls the heavier.
people.subject: The moment: in a boat, he laughs aloud before the punchline and grins at the viewer. His uncle pulls the heavier stroke and he laughs at nothing in particular. Face: a wide, cheerful, freckled round face; big bright eyes; thick messy brows; a gap-toothed mouth wide open in a laugh. There are freckles on his nose and a missing front tooth. Hair: black, short and spiky. Body: stocky, small, loose and bouncy. His round belly shakes as he laughs. He is short and round, with the belly of a boy who eats whatever is offered. Clothing: a pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp with sleeves rolled, wet at the cuffs. The robe's hem is wet and a loose thread hangs from one sleeve. Hands and objects: both hands on a long oar; the oar blade dripping. The oar's wet blade throws drops that glitter; a second pair of hands, his uncle's one hand, grips the other oar at the frame edge. Background: blurred pond with reeds, a second oar and a man's sleeve at the edge. A pond with a flock of ducks and a second pair of oars leaning on a post. Light: bright light from the upper left; faint orange-brown shimmer. Bright mid-morning light from the upper left, sparkles of water on the oar. Expression: merry, lazy, loud. He is merry, and truly does not mind.

people.imagined: On the reed harbour in the evening, shins scarred by reeds, planning the day she rows her great-grandfather to the Evening Isle.
people.subject: The moment: standing in a small reed boat, she gives a level boatwoman's steady look at the viewer. She has marked the exact stroke it will take to reach the isle and her eyes go to the grey sea. Face: a calm, brown, open face; steady dark-grey eyes; straight brows; a small firm mouth; wind lines. Salt has dried at her temples and she has a straight, strong nose. Hair: black, in a thick braid wound around her head. Body: strong, lean, long-armed. She stands with her feet braced and the boat does not rock. Clothing: a pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp with the hem tied up high, showing reed-cut shins marked with many thin white scars, clearly visible; a reed rain cape on the shoulders. The reed cape is thick and neatly layered and the sash is black. Hands and objects: both hands hold a long oar; a coiled rope at her feet. The coil of rope at her feet is new and pale yellow. Background: blurred reed harbour at dusk, a pale sea. Tall reeds, brown and gold, rise in the dusk and one lamp shines on the harbour. Light: low red-gold light from the upper left; faint blue-grey shimmer. Expression: level, calm, compassionate. Calm and quite ready.

people.imagined: A runner stopping on a road, calves hard, lips split by wind, a message in her hand for the Watch.
people.subject: The moment: on a windy road, she halts mid-run and looks at the viewer, panting, her lips split. She has reached the post and has only a breath to speak before she must run back. Face: a lean, windburnt, brown face; bright dark eyes; straight brows; the lower lip cracked and split with red; a short nose. The lips bleed at the cracks and her nose is peeling. Hair: black, in a tight single braid. Body: lean, wiry, athletic with strong calves. Her calves are hard and ridged and her breath comes in gusts. Clothing: an inner-gate rust robe of fine hemp, hem tied up above the knee, a dusk-violet collar; leather sandals. The sandals are laced with leather thongs up to the shin and the hem is spattered with dust. The collar is darkened with sweat, a leather strap crosses her chest to hold the tube, and the sleeves are tied above the elbow. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a small cloth-wrapped message tube; the left on her side. The message tube is bamboo sealed with red wax and tied with a cord. Her left hand is pressed flat to her ribs where a stitch is burning. Background: blurred steppe road, dust, a pale sky. A dusty road bends toward a small grey watch house. Light: bright hard light from the upper left; faint grey-brown shimmer. Harsh wind-blown light from the upper left, dust hanging in the air behind her. Expression: diligent, wary, loyal. Diligent and wary.

people.imagined: At night on a river wall, looking over the dark water at Thính Vũ's lamps with clean scholar's hands folded behind him and a smile held a little too long.
people.subject: The moment: at night on a river wall, he turns and smiles slowly at the viewer, the smile held too long. Across the river a dim line of lamps burns and he smiles, because he knows a skiff is out there. Face: a handsome, cold, narrow face; pale clean skin; a scar through the left eyebrow, clearly visible; cool dark eyes; a straight nose; thin lips in a lingering smile. His lips are thin and his teeth are even and very white. Hair: black, in a high knot with a silver pin. Body: tall, lean, very still. He stands with one hip against the wall, relaxed like a cat. His wrists are narrow and his fingers long and perfectly clean, nails pared square. Clothing: an inner-gate rust robe of fine hemp with a sea-grey coat, perfectly clean. The silver pin is shaped like a fish, and the coat's cuffs are spotless. Hands and objects: the hands, white and clean like a scholar's, lie folded in front of the belt. A thin white jade ring on the left forefinger is the only ornament on his hands. Background: blurred black water with tiny distant lamp lights. Black water laps the stones of the wall and the lamps are tiny yellow points. Light: cold moonlight from the upper left; faint blue-grey shimmer. Cold silver moonlight from the upper left rims his profile and the scar through the eyebrow. Expression: cold, arrogant, pleased. He seems pleased with the night.

people.imagined: A fisher boy at the outer gate, bird-thin chest swelling, startling everyone with a deep clear note.
people.subject: The moment: a fisher boy at the outer gate, mid-song, his bird-thin chest swelling and his mouth wide open, looks at the viewer with surprise at his own voice, the first full note ringing across the yard and everyone turning to stare. Face: a thin, brown, open face with wide dark eyes, thin brows, sun freckles, large ears and a mouth wide open on a clear note, the collarbones showing above the collar. Hair: black, short and untidy, cropped by a fisherman's knife and longer on one side. Body: a bird-thin chest and narrow shoulders, the ribs rising visibly under the robe as he breathes in. Clothing: a clean pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp, a little loose, the sleeves too long and rolled twice, a stern-lamp clasp at the collar. Hands and objects: one hand spread flat over his breastbone and the other held out, palm up, as if offering the note. Background: a wooden outer-gate yard with a row of washed lamps hanging on a rail, a pale orange dusk sky. Light: warm low dusk light from the upper left. Qi: a faint blue-grey shimmer. Expression: startled, sweet and trusting, the eyes round and the whole thin face given over to the note, more surprised by his own voice than anyone in the yard.

people.imagined: Drilling with the cadets she was not invited to, biting her lower lip until it scabs, after breaking a boy's wrist and not stopping.
people.subject: The moment: in a drill rank, she grits her teeth and bites her lower lip, glaring ahead and sidelong at the viewer. She has just broken a wrist and kept drilling, and her lip is bitten. Face: a hard, thin, sharp young face; dark intense eyes; heavy straight brows; a scabbed lower lip, bitten raw and crusted, clearly visible. A tiny scar lies in her left eyebrow. Hair: black, in a tight high braid. A few short hairs have escaped the braid and stick to her damp forehead. Body: slim, rigid, strong. Her fists are tight and her heels dug in. Clothing: a pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp, tightly belted; a cadet's grey goose-feather pin on the collar. The belt is tied so tight the robe puckers. Hands and objects: both hands grip a wooden drill spear; the knuckles white. The drill spear is plain ash wood with a brass cap, gripped so tightly the knuckles are pale; a smear of blood from the lip is on her sleeve. Background: blurred drill ground, ranks of small figures, dust. A dusty drill ground with a rank of cadets and a boy holding a splinted wrist. Light: bright pale light from the upper left; faint grey shimmer. Hard flat white light from the upper left, throwing a short shadow. Expression: ambitious, callous, impatient. She is fierce and not sorry.

people.imagined: In the old seat's kitchen at midwinter, flour in her eyebrows, a jar of pebbles in her hand for the thick end of the pot, daring anyone to laugh.
people.subject: The moment: in a steaming kitchen at midwinter she holds up a jar and a ladle and glares at the viewer, daring anyone to laugh; the lots are drawn for the thick end of the pot and a boy has laughed at her bun. Face (most important: a shiny pink burn scar on one cheek, plainly visible, and flour-white eyebrows): a broad, round, red face shiny with steam, with small sharp eyes, a stubborn jaw and a doubling chin. Hair: grey, in a tight bun under a white cloth with a streak of flour across it. Body: broad, short and strong-armed, aproned, standing with her hands on her hips and her feet planted. Clothing: a rust robe of strong hemp under a big flour-dusted apron, the sleeves rolled to the elbow and the cuffs caked with dough. Hands and objects: one hand holds a big wooden ladle; the other a glass jar of small white pebbles. Background: a blurred kitchen with a huge black iron pot steaming on a stove and rows of ladles hanging on the wall. Light: warm firelight from the lower left. Qi: a faint orange shimmer. Expression: a stern glare, the chin lifted and the mouth set, generous and stubborn, kind enough underneath that the glare is a dare rather than a threat.

people.imagined: In a small boat at the edge of an evening isle, with a bald brown head and eyes the colour of river water. He has rowed more dying elders than anyone but one.
people.subject: The moment: sitting in a boat, resting on his oars, he gazes calmly at the viewer with pale river-coloured eyes. The boat has stopped and he looks across the water. Face: a lined, brown, bald head; eyes a pale water-grey-green, strikingly light in a dark face; sparse white eyebrows; a thin calm mouth. His ears stick out and the skin of his head is spotted with brown marks. Hair: none, bald, with a few white whiskers. Body: lean, long-limbed, worn. His long arms hang loosely between his knees. He sits with his back to the bow, his bare feet braced on the bottom boards. Clothing: a faded but clean pale ochre robe of hemp, a reed rain cape across the shoulders. The cape is brown reed, bound with a cord of twisted grass. Hands and objects: both gnarled brown hands hold the oars at rest. The oars are black with age and polished pale at the grips; a coil of wet grey rope lies at his heel. Background: blurred still evening water, a low isle in the mist. Dark water and a low isle with a single pale tree. Light: soft red-gold evening light from the upper left; faint blue-grey shimmer. A low red-gold light skims the water and lights the dome of his head. Expression: calm, reclusive, patient. There is a deep calm in him.

people.imagined: Panning a river for silver flakes on a rest day, wet hands glittering, hiding a small pouch.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling at a river edge, she lifts wet hands that glitter with silver and glances nervously at the viewer. She has found a fleck and looks about to see who saw. Face: a small, round, damp face; sharp dark eyes; arched brows; a small tight mouth; a faint greedy glint. Her cheeks are chapped and her eyebrows thin. Hair: black, in two tight braids. Two tight braids are tied with scraps of green thread, and wet strands cling to her cheeks. Body: small, wiry. She kneels with her knees in wet pebbles. Clothing: a pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp, sleeves rolled, wet at the cuffs; a small cloth pouch tied at the waist. The pouch at her waist is tied with three knots and bulges. Hands and objects: both wet hands sparkle with fine silver flakes in the palms, clearly visible; a shallow wooden pan in front of her. The wooden pan is round and shallow and rimmed in dark water; in the flat of her palm a dozen silver flakes shine like tiny fish scales. Background: blurred shallow river and stones. A shallow stony river runs bright and a small wooden pan lies in the water. Light: bright light from the upper left; silver-white sparkle. Bright sun on the water throws moving ripples of light on her face. Expression: patient, greedy, cautious. Her patience is full of greed.

people.imagined: At the outer gate stifling a yawn badly, with a new silver ring she should not have, thinking of a stall.
people.subject: The moment: stifling a big yawn behind her hand, she eyes the viewer sleepily during a long lecture, a new silver ring flashing on the other hand, thinking of a stall. Face: a pretty, soft, round face with light brown skin, heavy-lidded slightly puffy eyes, full lips parted in the yawn. Hair: black, loose in a long half-tail with a bright pink ribbon tied in a loose bow, a few strands falling across her eyes. Body: soft, relaxed and slouching against a pillar. Clothing: a clean pale ochre outer-gate robe of fine hemp with the sleeves hanging loose and a bright pink sash tied in a bow with a tassel. Hands and objects: the left hand over her mouth in the yawn; on the right middle finger a thin, plain, bright silver ring with a small smooth flat top, clearly visible. Background: a blurred outer-gate yard with a bench, a pillar and an empty bowl. Light: warm sleepy afternoon light from the upper left, slanting through a gap. Qi: a faint brown shimmer. Expression: sleepy and bored with a glint of cunning behind it, the eyelids low and the mind plainly elsewhere, a practical girl calculating what a stall could earn.

people.imagined: On the drill field, head cocked to listen as his father does, a good cadet who fears what his father wants.
people.subject: The moment: on the drill field, he cocks his head to listen and looks sideways at the viewer with a worried frown, a good cadet who fears what his father wants, down the field his father's voice dropping quiet. Face: a long, earnest, handsome young face with steady grey-brown eyes, straight brows, a straight nose, a worried mouth and a muscle tightening in the jaw. Hair: black, in a topknot tied so flat it seems drawn on his head, not a hair loose. Body: tall, straight-backed and lean, his stance perfect and the spear exactly vertical. Clothing: an inner-gate rust robe of fine hemp with a dusk-violet collar, closed by a tiny grey goose-feather pin. Hands and objects: one hand holds a plain ash drill spear with a bright iron tip upright; the other lightly touches his ear with long, still fingers. Background: a blurred long dusty drill field with rows of cadets in rust robes, ranks of marching figures. Light: cool, even grey dawn light from the upper left. Qi: a faint grey-brown shimmer. Expression: a worried, cautious look under perfect discipline, the brows drawn and the mouth tight, a peaceable young man listening for the thing his father is not saying.

people.imagined: Carrying a lit stern lamp up the river path, oil on her sleeves, not blinking at the flame.
people.subject: The moment: holding a lit round stern lantern in both hands at her chest, she stares at the viewer without blinking, having carried her lamp up the river path when the village lit its lamps. Face: a round, solemn, pale face with wide unblinking dark eyes holding the flame's reflection, thin brows, long lashes catching the light and a small closed mouth. Hair: black, in a plain bun with a red thread wound twice through it and the ends trailing down her neck. Body: small and slender, standing very still with her elbows tucked in. Clothing: a clean pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp, a little small for her, both sleeves darkened with lamp oil to the elbow, the hem damp from the river and a stern-lamp clasp at the collar. Hands and objects: both hands hold a round orange stern lamp with a steady flame, clearly lit. Background: a blurred river path at dusk with dark reeds and one distant lit window, a dark bank. Light: warm orange lamp light on her face from below, lighting the underside of her chin and lashes gold, with deep blue dusk behind. Expression: devout, steady and unblinking, the mouth closed and the eyes fixed on the flame, a humble girl who believes the light is hers to carry.

people.imagined: Copying a contract in the Hall of Scales with a pencil behind one ear, a jade comb in her hair she should not have, thumb pads ink-grey.
people.subject: The moment: at a copying desk in the Hall of Scales, she looks up from a sheet and tilts her head, a pencil behind her ear, a clause altered and the next about to be written. Face: a thin, pale, composed face with clever narrow grey-brown eyes, thin straight brows, a neat small mouth, a faint dimple on one cheek and a reserved look. Hair: black, in a low coil with a green jade comb, clearly visible. Body: slim, upright and sitting with perfect posture, the shoulders narrow and the neck long. Clothing: an inner-gate rust robe of fine hemp with a plain dusk-violet collar, the sleeves tied back with grey cord. Hands and objects: a thin charcoal pencil behind one ear; both thumb pads ink-grey; a brush held over a sheet of neat tiny rows of small marks, no characters; her left hand rests on a small box of jade combs, two of them showing green, and a second sheet is weighted down with a stone. Background: blurred wooden desks with neat piles of paper and tall shelves of scrolls. Light: cool grey light from the upper left falling flat on the paper. Qi: a faint grey shimmer. Expression: composed and secretive, the eyes level and a flicker of private cunning at the corner of the mouth, a precise young woman who keeps her own copy of everything.

people.imagined: At the forge, going still because steel is near. He has felt a sword hum and told no one.
people.subject: The moment: standing frozen beside a rack of steel in the forge with his head turned toward a sword just out of frame, then toward the viewer with wide eyes; a blade has hummed on the rack, he has felt it before and told no one. Face: a lean, soot-smudged, honest face with wide dark eyes, thick brows, a short nose, a slightly open mouth and a smear of soot across the forehead. Hair: black and short, singed at the front and standing up in tufts. Body: thin and wiry with lean, corded, forge-hardened forearms. Clothing: a rust leather apron too big for him, tied in two turns, over a clean pale ochre robe with the sleeves rolled up. Hands and objects: both hands held very still at his sides; at the edge of the frame a long sword in a plain scabbard lies on the rack, its guard catching a small thread of blue-white light. Background: a blurred forge glowing orange with a rack of swords catching the light. Light: orange forge light from the lower left on one side and a thin cold blue-white gleam from the rack on the other. Expression: honest, awed and trusting, the lips parted and the eyes wide, the stillness of a boy who has just heard steel speak.

people.imagined: On a meditation mat in the front row, unable to sit three breaths. A mat-weave pattern is printed in her palm.
people.subject: The moment: fidgeting on a mat, she holds up one palm showing a crisscross weave pattern printed in it and grins at the viewer. She is made to sit again in the front row. Face: a lively, narrow, bright face; bright restless dark eyes; arched brows; a quick smile; a few freckles. Her lashes are long and a tiny scar marks her chin. Hair: black, in a loose high tail, bobbing. The high tail is tied with a bit of mat-reed instead of ribbon. Body: small, fidgety. Her knees jig under the robe. Clothing: a pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp, a green sash, sleeves loose. The green sash is knotted askew. Hands and objects: the right palm raised, red with a clearly visible crisscross woven-mat pattern imprinted on it. The left hand holds a half-woven strip of straw, its ends sticking out between her fingers. Background: blurred meditation hall with rows of woven mats. Rows of woven mats cover the hall floor and a high window shows sky. Light: soft light from the upper left; faint brown-green shimmer. Soft light from a high window falls in a patch on the mats and warms the side of her face. Expression: restless, cheerful, impatient. Restless and bright.

people.imagined: Making pill moulds, hands stained purple to the wrist that no soap has lifted, and a quiet smile.
people.subject: The moment: holding up both purple-stained hands with a shy smile, a clay pill mould between them, after pressing a hundred moulds this week. Face: a calm, plain, round face with round cheeks, kind dark eyes, thin brows, a small smile and a purple smudge on the chin. Hair: black, in a low plain bun held by a wooden pin, wisps sticking to her damp temple. Body: stocky and steady. Clothing: an inner-gate rust robe of fine hemp with a dusk-violet collar, the sleeves pushed to the elbow. Hands and objects: both hands and wrists stained deep purple to the wrist, clearly visible, the colour with a faint blue sheen that no soap has lifted; between them a palm-sized brown clay mould with seven round hollows in a ring, still damp. Background: a blurred workbench with rows of clay moulds and a small window. Behind the bench a shelf holds jars of purple dye and bowls of fine clay powder, and a window looks onto a courtyard wall washed pale gold by the afternoon. Light: warm window light from the upper left lighting the purple of her hands. Qi: a faint green-gold shimmer. Expression: a quiet, a little shy, diligent smile, the eyes kind and the head slightly lowered, a humble woman proud of one small useful thing.

people.imagined: At his trade-office desk, rubbing the callus on his forefinger while he tells a pleasant lie to a visitor.
people.subject: The moment: behind a desk in his trade office, he rubs the callus on his right forefinger with his thumb while smiling at the viewer, a cask of wine on the desk and a visitor asking about a client, telling a pleasant lie. Face: a smooth, round, pleasant face with fair skin, friendly dark eyes, thick brows, a neat small moustache, a double chin, a small mole by the nose and a practised warm smile. Hair: black, in a tidy knot held by a wooden pin. Body: plump, comfortable and relaxed, sitting with his elbows on the desk and his fingertips together. Clothing: a rust robe of fine hemp with a crisp dusk-violet collar of excellent cloth and a deep ochre sash with a gold thread through it, the sleeves tied back. Hands and objects: the right forefinger shows a big yellow callus, rubbed by the thumb, clearly visible; under the left hand a tally book with a green cover and tiny marks, no characters. Background: blurred shelves of tally books with red tags in a market office. Light: warm lamp light from the upper left throwing a soft shadow of his chin. Qi: a faint brown shimmer. Expression: a smooth, patient, practised warmth that does not reach the eyes, the head tilted slightly as if to invite your trust.

people.imagined: At sunset in the Hall of Scales, a small dry frame filled with a rich carrying voice, reading oaths aloud with her chin lifted.
people.subject: The moment: reading from an open scroll with her chin lifted and her mouth open in a full ringing voice, eyes on the viewer. The sun has just touched the horizon and she begins the oath. Face: a small, dry, narrow face; fair skin; steady dark eyes; strong straight brows; a wide mouth open in speech; a firm chin. Her neck is thin and the tendons stand out as she speaks. Hair: black, in a tight bun with a bronze pin. A single bronze pin holds the bun; two stray hairs fall at the temple. Body: small, thin, very upright. Her chest is small but her breath is deep. Clothing: a rust inner-gate robe of fine hemp with a dusk-violet collar, sleeves tied back. Her sleeves are tied with brown cord. The robe's dusk-violet is pressed to a crisp edge and a black cord ties the cuffs. Hands and objects: both hands hold open a long blank paper scroll with rows of faint marks and no characters. The scroll is long and the edge curls. Background: blurred pillared hall with a red sunset in the window. Tall dark pillars rise in the hall and a red band of sunset fills the window. Light: low red sunset light from the upper left; faint brown shimmer. The red sunset floods from the window behind and warms the side of her cheek. Expression: just, honest, resonant. She is firm and clear.

people.imagined: Emerging from a gallery shaft, rock dust ground into his knees and a pickaxe on his shoulder. He would bring the village up if anyone paid.
people.subject: The moment: climbing out of a shaft mouth, he rests a pickaxe on his shoulder and looks at the viewer with a loyal steady stare, the sun surprising him after the dark, ready to bring the village up if anyone paid. Face: a square, dusty, brown face with steady dark eyes, thick brows grey with dust, a broad nose, a scar splitting the left eyebrow, a short beard shadow and a firm mouth. Hair: black, cropped short and turned grey by dust. Body: broad, thick-armed and strong, with thick thighs and a wide stance. Clothing: a rust inner-gate robe of fine hemp with a dusk-violet collar open on a dust-streaked neck, thick rust cloth over both elbows, the knees grey-white with ground rock dust, the sleeves rolled, a rope belt. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a short iron pickaxe on the shoulder; on the other side a dented, blackened tin lamp hangs on a short strap. Background: a blurred dark shaft mouth with a ladder rising from it behind him. Light: dim warm light from the upper left, with a bright slot of sky above the shaft and the light of a nearby lamp. Qi: a faint silver-grey shimmer. Expression: a loyal, steady, brave diligence, the mouth firm and the eyes narrowed against the sun, a man who wants work for his village and is prepared to dig for it.

people.imagined: On the drill ground, a dent in her brow where a well-rope slipped, signing a petition behind her master's back with a bold stroke.
people.subject: The moment: drilling a second line, she stands hard and glares at the viewer, a dent plain in her forehead. She signed a petition behind her master's back and her hand does not shake. Face: a hard, strong, broad face; tanned skin; a deep dent in her brow above one eye, plainly visible; fierce dark eyes; heavy brows; a firm jaw. Her nose is flat and her cheeks are weathered. Hair: black, tightly braided and pinned flat. Two iron pins hold the braid. Body: broad-shouldered, solid, upright. Her stance is wide and her fists are tight. Clothing: a rust inner-gate robe of fine hemp with a dusk-violet collar tightly belted; a grey goose-feather pin at the collar. Her belt buckle is square brass. The jacket is tight at the shoulders and bound with a leather belt; the sleeves are rolled. Hands and objects: both hands grip a drill spear; a folded paper tucked in the belt. The folded paper in her belt shows a corner of red wax; the spear is ash with a bright cap. Background: blurred drill ground with ranks of figures. Ranks of cadets stand in the dust. Light: hard light from the upper left; faint grey-brown shimmer. Hard bright light from the upper left on the dusty ground. Expression: warlike, brave, hard. Hard and bold.

people.imagined: In the tea terraces with a wide hat tied under her chin with a purple cord, pricing a pill a tenth under a rival.
people.subject: The moment: under a wide tea-grower's hat tied with a purple cord, she looks briskly at the viewer, a small pill case in hand, having priced her pill a tenth under the rival's again. Face: a round, brown, shrewd face with plump tanned cheeks, bright quick dark eyes, arched brows, a firm small mouth and a pointed chin. Hair: black, mostly hidden under the hat, a tuft escaping. Body: stocky, brisk and capable, standing square with her chest out, her arms strong from picking and her legs planted wide on the terrace. Clothing: an inner-gate rust robe of fine hemp with a dusk-violet collar, hitched at the hem and tied with a purple sash that matches the hat cord, the sleeves rolled and the cuffs stained green with tea; a wide round straw hat with a purple cord tied under the chin, clearly visible. Hands and objects: the right hand holds up a small round lacquered pill box; the left a sprig of green tea. Background: blurred terraced rows of tea bushes running up a hillside with red maples. Light: bright warm tea-terrace light from the upper left, green reflected on her chin. Qi: a faint green-gold shimmer. Expression: brisk and ambitious, the brows arched and the mouth pressed in a small satisfied line, a hard-working woman who knows the price of everything and has just beaten a rival to it.

people.imagined: At the helm of a river boat, a broken, badly set finger on the tiller, eyes on the horizon where a sea boat waits.
people.subject: The moment: at a boat tiller, she looks at the viewer with an ambitious sideways glance, one finger crooked, the sea boat out there and her not on it. Face: a sharp, handsome, weathered face with olive skin, bold dark eyes, strong arched brows, a straight nose, a confident mouth and a thin white scar above the lip. Hair: black, in a high tail with a faded blue ribbon. Body: lean, strong and balanced, her legs braced and her back straight. Clothing: a rust inner-gate robe of fine hemp with a dusk-violet collar open at the neck, the sleeves rolled to the elbow, and a sea-grey short cloak pinned with a shining brass fish. Hands and objects: the right hand grips a smooth black wooden tiller with a carved head, the index finger bent sideways at the middle joint, badly set and swollen at the joint, clearly visible. Background: a blurred wide pale river meeting the sea on a far horizon. Light: bright cold river light from the upper left. Qi: a faint blue-grey shimmer. Expression: ambitious, impatient and hungry, the gaze pulled toward the horizon and the jaw lifted, a woman who counts every day on the river as a day not at sea.

people.imagined: On the steppe road with a satchel rubbed pale at the clasp, carrying a list of thirty he does not like to carry.
people.subject: The moment: on a dusty steppe road, he holds a leather satchel against his chest and looks at the viewer with a loyal, uneasy stare, the list of thirty in the bag and the road still long. Face: a long, thin, plain, honest, tanned face with worried red-rimmed brown eyes, level brows, a short nose, a closed mouth, grey stubble on the jaw, tired lines below the eyes and a patient set to the mouth. Hair: black, in a plain knot with a grey strand at the temple. Body: tall and lean with the slight stoop of a man who has walked a lifetime of roads, his shoulders sagging under the satchel. Clothing: a rust inner-gate robe of fine hemp with a dusk-violet collar, dusty to the knees, under a brown wool travelling cloak dusted pale and lined in dusk-violet, with road-scuffed boots. Hands and objects: the satchel held in both hands, its clasp rubbed pale and shiny, clearly visible. Background: a long steppe road in dust reaching a pale horizon, a pale ribbon of road crossing the yellow grass far behind him with a single tiny wagon on it. Light: bright flat sun on the road with no shadows. Qi: a faint brown shimmer. Expression: uneasy and loyal, the brows level but tight and the mouth closed on what he knows, a cautious man carrying a list he does not like to carry.

people.imagined: At the edge of the grey, one grey patch on his wrist, left hand missing two fingers, a hard stare for the treasure seekers.
people.subject: The moment: at the miasma's edge, he holds up his left hand with two fingers missing and looks harshly at the viewer, a captured treasure-seeker staked at the grey's edge and him checking the rope. Face: a hard, craggy, sun-black face with narrow cold eyes, heavy brows, a flat nose with a scar across the bridge, a thin cruel mouth and stubble. Hair: grey-black, cropped short, a dusty cap pushed to the back of the head. Body: broad, rough and thickset, standing with his weight on one leg. Clothing: a grey felt coat, scorched at one cuff and repaired with leather, over an ash-grey robe with a dusk-violet collar edge. Hands and objects: the left hand raised, only the thumb, forefinger and little finger present, the two middle fingers gone and a grey ash-like stain on the wrist, clearly visible; the right hand grips a dark wooden stake sharpened at the tip. Background: blurred grey miasma mist and ash, with stakes marking the creep of the grey like a line of teeth. Light: pale grey-green light from the left, a distant lantern's glow under a leaden grey sky. Qi: a faint brown shimmer. Expression: a pitiless, warlike stare, the mouth thin and the eyes cold, a loyal man who has stopped expecting mercy from anything.

people.imagined: Awake at night on a river wall counting lamps. The lamp-counters call him the Owl for his sleepless face.
people.subject: The moment: on a night river wall, he stares unblinking at the viewer with wide sleepless eyes, one hand holding a knotted cord, having noticed a gap in the line of lamps where one should be; the lamp-counters call him the Owl for his sleepless face. Face: a lean, pale, owlish face with very round wide-open dark eyes under deep shadows, heavy brows, a hooked nose, hollow cheeks and a thin tight mouth. Hair: grey-black, in a tight topknot tied with black string. Body: thin, hunched and alert, hugging himself against the cold. Clothing: a rust inner-gate robe of fine hemp with a dusk-violet collar and the sleeves tied with black thread, under a long sea-grey coat of good cloth with horn buttons. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a cord with many knots in groups of five, the last knot bright red, clearly visible; the left rests on the wall. Background: a blurred black river with a far line of small yellow lamps scattered across the water. Light: the cold light of a thin moon from the upper left, tiny lamps reflected in the black water. Qi: a faint blue-grey shimmer. Expression: wide-eyed, worn and watchful, the brows lifted and the thin mouth tight, a patient, suspicious man who trusts no lamp he has not counted himself.

people.imagined: On a pitching dock, one hand on a rail, her face a faint seasick green, tallying stores and debts.
people.subject: The moment: on a pitching dock, she grips a rail with one hand and looks at the viewer with a wan seasick look as a wave lifts the dock and she holds on tighter, tallying stores and debts. Face: a thin, pale face with a greenish tinge that does not leave, tired watery dark eyes, thin brows, pale lips and a thin mouth pressed tight. Hair: black, in a neat low bun held by a silver pin, a few loose hairs damp with sea spray. Body: frail, thin and bent slightly, her knees slightly flexed against the motion. Clothing: a rust inner-gate robe of fine hemp with a dusk-violet collar and a sea-grey shawl knotted at the chest. Hands and objects: one hand clamps the wet rail, slick and green with weed; the other holds a small counting board with two rows of bone beads. Background: blurred boats with creaking ropes on grey water. Light: dim cold grey light from the upper left, the water the colour of pewter. Qi: a faint grey shimmer. Expression: wan and queasy with a streak of impatience, the lips tight and the eyes narrowed, a practical woman who intends to finish the count before she is sick.

people.imagined: At the armoury bench in a smith's apron he has not taken off, arguing, wine cup near the steel.
people.subject: The moment: at the armoury bench in a smith's apron he has not taken off, he points a finger at the viewer in mid-argument, a smith having brought him wine and him waving a hand at the good steel. Face: a ruddy, proud, heavy face with small angry dark eyes, thick brows, a big red nose and a pouting lower lip that juts out. Hair: black, tied in a rough knot held by a bit of wire, a greasy lock hanging over the forehead. Body: stocky and thick-armed with broad shoulders, a short neck and a thick chest, the belly pushing the apron as he leans back with his chin lifted, strutting. Clothing: a greasy leather smith's apron with a long burn across the belly over a rust robe stained with wine, the sleeves rolled. Hands and objects: the right forefinger jabs forward; on the bench beside him a cup of wine stands next to a bar of grey steel. Background: a blurred forge glowing behind him with a rack of steel bars. Light: orange light of the coals from the lower left, a red gleam on his cheek. Qi: a faint orange shimmer. Expression: proud and quarrelsome, the eyes narrowed in suspicion and the chin thrust out, as though everyone in the room is after his steel.

people.imagined: On the beach of the Evening Isle, a spade in sand and a sailcloth cap tied under his chin, blisters on both palms.
people.subject: The moment: on a beach lined with graves on the Evening Isle, he leans on a spade facing west and looks at the viewer calmly, having dug the thirty-second grave this week and rested at its edge, a sail laid over the keeper's grave already dug. Face: a weathered, calm, brown face with a lined brow, deep creases at the mouth, deep-set quiet eyes, sparse grey brows, a long nose and a still mouth. Hair: grey, under a sailcloth cap tied with a cord under the chin, clearly visible, a few white hairs showing at the ears. Body: lean, long and slightly bent from digging. Clothing: a plain pale ochre robe of hemp, clean, the hem darkened with beach damp, the sleeves rolled to the elbow over thin brown forearms, and a sea-grey sash. Hands and objects: one palm turned up showing white, swollen spade blisters; the other grips the spade, whose blade is worn bright at the edge and whose handle is wrapped with strips of sailcloth. Background: low mounds in rows on the sand facing a red west, grey stones and a blurred beach. Light: low red evening light from the upper left on the sand and the grey stones. Qi: a faint blue-grey shimmer. Expression: calm, devout and quiet, the eyes steady on the setting sun and the mouth at rest, a man who has made peace with the work of burying.

people.imagined: On the steppe at dusk, narrow pale eyes watching palms until full dark, writing down who lets the glow go.
people.subject: The moment: on a darkening steppe, she watches a row of palms and narrows her pale eyes at the viewer. The light is almost gone and one palm still glows. Face: a thin, stern, weathered face; pale grey eyes narrowed against the sun; straight thin brows; a long nose; a tight dry mouth. Her lips are thin and cracked. Hair: black, in one long dry braid over the shoulder, clearly visible. Body: tall, spare, rigid. She stands with her back straight and hands behind. Clothing: a rust inner-gate robe of fine hemp with a dusk-violet collar tightly belted. The belt is tight and plain. Hands and objects: one hand holds a small tablet and a brush; she watches a line of open palms at the frame edge. The tablet is a thin slab of wood with rows of tiny marks and a brush hangs from it; at the edge of the frame a row of small open palms glows faintly gold. Background: blurred orange dusk steppe. A wide plain turning from gold to grey. Light: low orange light from the upper left; faint brown shimmer. The last orange light from the upper left, and cool blue dusk behind. Expression: just, callous, patient. Fair and cold.

people.imagined: At the head of a caravan in a sheepskin vest over silk, jewelled left hand raised, bargaining at war prices.
people.subject: The moment: on a caravan road, he raises a left hand covered in rings and grins at the viewer. He is selling mutton at war prices and bargaining loudly. The caravan has halted at the Hạc Đinh crossing and he shouts a price over the noise of oxen. Face: a ruddy, broad, florid face; shrewd small eyes; heavy brows; a big nose; a white moustache; a wide greedy smile. His nose is veined and his cheeks are heavy. Hair: white, in a high knot. A white moustache curls at the ends. Body: stout, broad, swaggering. A big belly pushes the vest. Clothing: a sheepskin vest over a rust silk robe with a dusk-violet sash. The silk robe has a fine pattern of clouds. The vest's fleece is yellowed and the silk beneath is rust with a cloud pattern woven in; the boots are polished and spurred. Hands and objects: a ring on every finger of the left hand, bronze, jade and gold, clearly visible; a whip in the right. The rings are chunky, one with a green jade eye, one with a red stone; the whip is coiled in his right hand. Background: blurred steppe caravan with wagons. A caravan of wagons and oxen moves in a haze of dust. Light: bright light from the upper left; faint brown shimmer. Strong bright light from the upper left, dust sparkling in the air. Expression: greedy, brave, hearty. Hearty and greedy. His grin is wide and a little too loud, and the eyes flick to everyone's purse.

people.imagined: Weighing a buy-out price, tapping an abacus bead once before he speaks, no malice but no mercy.
people.subject: The moment: at a table, he taps one bead of an abacus once with his forefinger and looks at the viewer evenly, a disciple wanting to buy out a term and him giving the price without any heat, no malice and no mercy. Face: a neat, dry, pale face with level grey eyes, thin straight brows, thin lips, neat ears and a trim line of moustache above a small mouth. Hair: black, in a tidy topknot held by a jade pin. Body: thin, upright and still, his back straight. Clothing: a pressed dusk-violet robe of fine hemp without embroidery, the cuffs folded exactly, and a rust sash knotted exactly in the centre. Hands and objects: the right forefinger rests on one polished black bead of a small abacus with brass wires on the table; beside it a perfect stack of narrow paper slips. Background: a blurred plain hall wall behind the table. The wall is pale plastered stone with no decoration at all, a narrow shelf holds one box of weights and a small bronze lamp stands unlit at the table's far corner. Light: cool grey light from the upper left, with no warmth in it. Qi: a faint grey-brown shimmer. Expression: calm and cold, a level gaze and a closed mouth, a temperate man who finds fairness in arithmetic and feels nothing about it.

people.imagined: Adding a caravan manifest in her head while her leg jiggles under every desk.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a desk, she grins quick and restless at the viewer, her whole body fidgeting, a caravan manifest adding itself in her head while the dusk practice bores her and her leg jiggles under the desk. Face: a bright, sharp, freckled face with quick dark eyes, high arched brows, a small nose and a wide grin showing small even teeth. Hair: black, in two tight buns tied with red cord, one slipped lower than the other. Body: small, wiry and restless, her knee visibly bobbing. Clothing: a clean pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp with the sleeves rolled unevenly and a bright red sash. Hands and objects: one hand counts off numbers on its fingers in the air while a pencil in the other taps the desk. Background: a blurred bright market office with tally books and a window. Behind her tall shelves hold neat rows of tally books with coloured tags, a window shows a bright strip of yard and a bronze weight sits on a stack of papers at the desk edge. Light: bright light from the upper left through the window. Qi: a faint brown shimmer. Expression: impatient and ambitious, the smile coming and going like a flicker and the face never still, a clever girl who finishes every sum before the teacher finishes the question.

people.imagined: Copying contracts with grey sleeve cuffs, a quiet glance at the head's own hand on an old loan.
people.subject: The moment: at a copying desk, he glances up with a careful look, one finger resting on a page, having noticed the head's own hand in the register of an old loan and saying nothing. Face: a thin, pale, careful face with wide cautious dark eyes, pale lashes, thin brows, a thin nose, pale lips and a faint worry line between the brows. Hair: black, in a neat topknot held by a plain black pin, the ears sticking out a little. Body: thin, narrow and stooped, his neck bent forward. Clothing: a rust inner-gate robe of fine hemp with a dusk-violet collar neatly pinned, the sleeve cuffs grey and shiny with ink, and a bone clasp holding the sash. Hands and objects: a fine brush in the right hand; the left forefinger on a sheet of neat rows of small marks, no characters; on the desk the register lies open to the loan, its page full of neat marks. Background: blurred tall shelves of scrolls. Light: cool light from a high window on the page and his hands. Qi: a faint grey shimmer. Expression: careful, honest and cautious, the face trying to stay blank and failing, a small crease of alarm showing between the brows.

people.imagined: Walking in with the wide careful steps of a man used to low roofs, ducking at every door.
people.subject: The moment: stepping through a low door, he ducks his head just in time and looks up at the viewer stubbornly and kindly, walking with the wide careful steps of a man used to low roofs. Face: a square, broad, brown face with steady dark eyes, thick brows, a flat nose, a generous wide mouth, a scar across the brow and a small white scar on the chin. Hair: black, chopped short, dusty and stiff. Body: broad and thick-set, stooping slightly, with very wide shoulders. Clothing: a thick pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp, dusty at the knees and sewn with leather knee guards for kneeling in galleries, and heavy miners' boots. Hands and objects: a rolled bundle on his back tied with a rope with a small iron hammer sticking out of it; one broad, scarred hand raised to guard his head from the lintel. Background: a low door of black wood and a pale yard beyond. Light: soft grey light from the upper left falling through the doorway behind him. Qi: a faint silver-grey shimmer. Expression: a kindly, stubborn, amiable look, the mouth wide and the brows level, a brave man who will carry your load without being asked.

people.imagined: On the archery line, a bow at full draw, a hand's width behind a better shot and sure it is the name.
people.subject: The moment: on the archery line, he lowers the bow slightly from full draw and glares sideways at the viewer, a shot having missed the centre by a hand's width and him sure the better shot has taken his name. Face: a lean, hard, brown face with a long jaw, a broad forehead, sharp dark eyes, strong brows, a flat nose and a thin set mouth. Hair: black, in a high knot tied with a leather thong, strands sticking to his sweating neck. Body: lean, muscular and upright with corded arms. Clothing: a rust inner-gate robe of fine hemp with a dusk-violet collar open at the throat and a thin dusk-violet band on the hem, the sleeves tied back, a leather arm guard and a brown leather quiver at the hip. Hands and objects: chapped fisherman's hands hold a long bow with polished horn tips and an arrow with grey fletching. Background: blurred archery butts, a long line of straw targets on a dusty field. Light: bright hard light from the upper left on the dry ground. Qi: a faint grey-brown shimmer. Expression: resentful and proud, the mouth a hard thin line and the eyes bright with a sense of injury, an ambitious archer who cannot forgive being second.

people.imagined: A goose pin and a ferry toll token swinging together on one cord, wanting the tolls back before she forms her foundation.
people.subject: The moment: standing straight, she lifts a cord bearing a goose pin and a ferry toll token and looks coldly at the viewer, remembering the night a toll clerk lost two fingers to the frost and wanting the tolls back before she forms her foundation. Face: a sharp, hard, pale face with high cheekbones, narrow cold eyes, thin straight brows, a straight nose and a thin tight mouth. Hair: black, in a tight high braid. Body: lean, tall and taut, her hands behind her back. Clothing: a rust inner-gate robe of fine hemp with the dusk-violet collar buttoned to the throat, narrow sleeves and a black leather belt. Hands and objects: on one cord at her chest a small grey goose-feather pin in a metal clasp and a square-holed copper toll token swing side by side, clearly visible. Background: a blurred wide drill field of packed pale earth stretching to a low wall, a rank of cadets in rust robes standing small and still and a wooden rack of spears at the edge. Light: hard pale light from the upper left. Qi: a faint grey-brown shimmer. Expression: a cold, proud, warlike stare, the lips thin and the chin high, loyal to a grudge that she has kept for years and has not once let go.

people.imagined: Sweeping the drying floor of the Maple Hall, a plain kindly face that people forget as soon as she leaves.
people.subject: The moment: holding a long straw broom on the drying floor of the Maple Hall, she smiles shyly at the viewer, worrying that her Earth will not rise twelve points, a plain kindly face that people forget as soon as she leaves. Face: a very plain, round, kind face, wide and mild, with rosy cheeks, low faint brows, small mild brown eyes, a short easily forgotten nose and a small smile. Hair: brown, in a plain bun held by two long brown pins, some hairs clinging to her cheeks. Body: sturdy and ordinary, her shoulders slumped. Her feet are set a little pigeon-toed on the swept boards, her back has the slight curve of someone who sweeps for hours, and her broad work-roughened hands grip the broom low and high. Clothing: a perfectly clean pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp with the sleeves tied back, and a brown linen apron dusted with green leaf crumbs. Hands and objects: both hands on a long broom of pale straw tied with a green string; a drift of red maple leaves lies at her feet. Background: a blurred drying floor with trays of leaves in rows. Light: soft golden light from the upper left on the drying trays. Qi: a faint green-gold shimmer. Expression: shy, humble and kind, worried but trying to look cheerful, the smile held a little too still.

people.imagined: Squatting like a rice-planter even indoors, content, waiting to be placed where there are fields.
people.subject: The moment: squatting low on his heels, he grins easily at the viewer as if in a field, content to be placed wherever there are fields, with his bottom nearly on his heels as if the floor were a paddy bank. Face: a round, sun-brown, peaceful face with kind small eyes, thick brows, big ears, a short nose, a cheerful chin and a wide easy smile. Hair: black, cropped short and full of straw dust. Body: stocky, low and relaxed, his knees wide. His thick forearms rest on his knees and his broad bare feet are planted flat and wide, toes spread, the posture of someone who has spent every morning of his life bent over a paddy. Clothing: a clean pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp with the sleeves rolled and the hem tied up, the cuffs muddy with grey clay. Hands and objects: both hands hold a loose bunch of bright green rice seedlings with white roots tied with a wet string. Background: a blurred wooden hall floor and a flooded field seen through a door. Light: soft light from the doorway spreading a bright rectangle on the floor. Qi: a faint green-gold shimmer. Expression: a content, peaceable, diligent smile, the face relaxed and the eyes half closed with pleasure, a farm boy who knows exactly where he belongs.

people.imagined: Singing the fourth verse on a boat, her long thin throat ringing like a bell.
people.subject: The moment: on a boat bow, she throws her head back and sings the fourth verse as it climbs and the boat rocks, her long throat showing, then glances at the viewer. Face (most important: a very long thin neck, plainly visible): a thin, bright, tanned face with narrow bright eyes, arched brows, a long nose, a pointed chin, a wide mouth open in song and a ring of tiny freckles around the nose. Hair: black, in a long braid tied with blue thread, hanging forward over one shoulder. Body: slender and long-necked, with a narrow chest. Clothing: a short, close-fitting rust inner-gate robe of fine hemp with an open dusk-violet collar closed by a small brass lamp clasp, the sleeves tied with red cord. Hands and objects: one hand cups her throat as if to feel the note; the other holds a wet brown rope. Background: a blurred river at dusk with a stern lamp. Light: warm light of the stern lamp lighting her chin and long throat. Qi: a faint blue-grey shimmer. Expression: bold and a little vain of her voice, the eyes sliding sideways to see who is listening, a sociable singer who changes her song to suit the crowd.

people.imagined: Humming with her mouth closed as her grandmother does, trying to find the verse the village stopped singing.
people.subject: The moment: with her mouth closed and her brows lifted, she hums and looks gently at the viewer, humming her grandmother's line as she tries to find the verse the village stopped singing. Face: a round, soft, honest face with light brown skin, round cheeks, a small flat nose, trusting dark eyes half closed in the hum and closed smiling lips. Hair: black, in two short braids tied with green thread that bob when she hums. Body: small, plump and gentle, her shoulders relaxed. She sways very slightly from side to side with the tune, her round chin tilted up and her weight on her heels, as though keeping time for a choir that is not there. Clothing: a clean pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp with a green sash and a small brass lamp clasp pinned at the collar. Hands and objects: one hand held to her throat, fingers resting on it to feel the hum; the other holds a corner of her sash. Background: a blurred choir hall with benches. Light: soft light from a window on the left lighting her round cheek. Qi: a faint blue-grey shimmer. Expression: a dreamy, trusting gentleness, a little smile curving the closed lips and the brows lifted in listening, an honest girl who believes the lost verse can still be found.

people.imagined: Copying sea charts by lamplight, ink on both ears, thinking of the third boat.
people.subject: The moment: at a lamp-lit table, he looks up from copying sea charts with ink-smeared ears and an eager stare, the third boat about to sail and him wanting a place on it. Face: a young, bold, thin face with a long nose, bright dark eyes, thin brows, a keen mouth and ink smears on both ears, a cheek and the jaw. Hair: black, in a messy knot tied with a bit of string, with ink in it too. Body: lean and restless, leaning forward with his elbows on the table. Clothing: a pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp with the cuffs inked and the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a trace of salt on the cloth, and a thin cord at his neck holding a small brass compass. Hands and objects: a fine, nearly dry brush in his hand over a chart covered with tiny stars and a coastline, no writing. Background: a blurred dark cabin with a lamp on a chain. Light: warm yellow lamp light from the upper left, swinging slightly. Qi: a faint blue-grey shimmer. Expression: eager, hungry and impatient, a half grin as if he already stood on the deck, a brave, ambitious young man with ink on his face and the horizon in his eyes.

people.imagined: Bamboo-brown arms, trying not to smile because she may go to Nhàn Vân Quán.
people.subject: The moment: holding her lips together to hide a smile, she looks at the viewer with bright eyes, hoping to be placed at Nhàn Vân Quán, her bamboo-brown arms bare. Face: a calm, round, golden face with smooth cheeks, bright dark eyes, straight soft brows and the corners of the mouth tucked in hard to stop the smile. Hair: black, in a single braid tied with a green string and ending in a small knot. Body: slim and strong-armed, standing with her arms at her sides. Her shoulders are held a little too straight with the effort of staying still, and her feet turn inward at the toes, restless in a way her calm face denies. Clothing: a clean pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp with a green sash, the sleeves rolled to the elbow and a bamboo-leaf pattern embroidered at the hem in pale thread. Hands and objects: both bamboo-brown forearms bare and tanned, marked with the pale green juice of cut bamboo; she holds a bamboo cutting knife with a curved blade and a worn wooden handle. Background: a blurred bamboo grove with tall green stalks. Light: soft green-filtered light from the upper left. Qi: a faint green shimmer. Expression: bright-eyed and almost trembling with the effort of not smiling, the lips pressed and the cheeks lifting anyway, humble and contained.

people.imagined: Drawing a miasma scar on his wrist with charcoal each morning, repeating his father's words.
people.subject: The moment: holding up his left wrist where a false scar is drawn in charcoal, he looks fiercely at the viewer, drawing the miasma scar each morning like a ritual and repeating his father's words. Face: a young, hard, tanned, square face with keen dark eyes, heavy brows and a firm jaw with a small cleft in the chin. Hair: black, chopped short and standing up at the crown. Body: lean and tense, standing with his chest out. His back is straight as a spear shaft, his feet planted a shoulder's width apart, and his free hand is clenched in a fist at his side as if on a hilt he has not been given. Clothing: a rust inner-gate robe of fine hemp with a dusk-violet collar, belted tight, under a short grey felt vest with a stitched dusk-violet edge. Hands and objects: a short black charcoal stick in one hand; on the other wrist a jagged, neat charcoal-drawn scar, smudged at one end, clearly visible. Background: a blurred grey watch house wall with a hook. Light: pale cold light from the upper left. Qi: a faint grey-brown shimmer. Expression: solemn and fierce, the jaw clenched and the gaze level, as if rehearsing his father's lines to a crowd that is not there, a brave and loyal young man who wants a wound he has not earned.

people.imagined: Squatting at the miasma's edge placing stones to mark where the grey moved in the night.
people.subject: The moment: squatting to read the ground at the miasma's edge, she looks up at the viewer with a careful calm, the grey having moved again in the night and her placing another stone to mark it. Face: a lean, shore-brown face with a long jaw, thin cheeks, patient grey-brown eyes, straight brows and a small tight quiet mouth. Hair: black, in a tight bun under a grey scarf with a few strands escaping. Body: lean and crouched, heels down, knees apart and forearms on her thighs, perfectly balanced. Clothing: a clean pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp under a grey felt vest. Hands and objects: one hand sets a smooth round grey stone on the ground at the end of a line of stones that recedes behind her into the mist. Background: a blurred grey plain of ash fading into pale mist with no horizon, the line of grey stones running into it, a few dead reed stalks standing stiff and a small unlit iron lantern near her knee. Light: pale grey-green light from the left. Qi: a faint grey shimmer. Expression: patient, cautious and unhurried, the eyes steady and the mouth quiet, a solitary woman reading the ground as if it were a page.

people.imagined: Counting lamps with knotted cords at her belt, a granddaughter beside the Owl, now counting the gaps.
people.subject: The moment: at night, she runs a knotted cord through her fingers and looks at the viewer with wary eyes, a granddaughter of the Owl, counting the gaps in the line of lamps where one is missing. Face: a thin, pale, serious face with hollow cheeks, small wide dark eyes, a pointed chin and thin brows drawn together over a tight mouth. Hair: black, in a tight braid tied with a knotted cord of black thread. Body: slim and alert, standing very still. She stands with her weight on one foot and her head slightly bowed, her narrow shoulders held tight, the posture of someone listening hard for a sound she has not yet heard. Clothing: a clean pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp under a grey sea cloak knotted at the neck with a cord, a row of tiny knots stitched along the collar. Hands and objects: a loop of knotted cords hangs at the belt like a fringe and one runs through her fingers, the knots in fives, clearly visible. Background: blurred night water with a far line of lamps and tiny points of reflection. Light: cold light from the upper left. Qi: a faint blue-grey shimmer. Expression: wary and worried, the lips pressed together and the eyes moving along the line, a diligent, honest girl who suspects that every missing lamp is a message.

people.imagined: At the armoury bellows, singed eyelashes, sworn to secrecy about a sword's hum.
people.subject: The moment: at the armoury bellows, she pumps with a bright grin and looks at the viewer, her eyelashes singed, sworn to secrecy about a sword's hum and pumping harder to keep it. Face (most important: singed short eyelashes, curled where the fire has taken them): a freckled, bright, sooty round face with big bold eyes, a snub nose and a wide grin. Hair: black, in a messy tail tied with a leather lace, the tips of the tufts singed. Body: small and wiry, with thin strong arms. Clothing: a clean pale ochre tunic of fine cloth under a thick leather apron with a scorched hem, the sleeves rolled to the shoulder. Hands and objects: both hands on the long bellows handle, dark wood worn smooth, sweat running on her forearms. Background: a blurred forge with orange coals. Behind her the forge is a cavern of rust-red brick with racks of long blades half in shadow, glowing coals heaped in a stone hearth and an anvil black against the fire. Light: orange coal glow from the lower left. Qi: a faint orange shimmer. Expression: merry and bold, a friendly grin with a secret kept firmly behind it, the face of a brave, sociable girl who has never once told what she heard.

people.imagined: Rowing on the evening water with her grandfather's slow level stare.
people.subject: The moment: at the oars of a small boat on evening water, she gives the viewer a slow level stare with her grandfather's eyes, having promised the second oar on the keeper's last row. Face: a calm, brown, round face with long lashes, pale water-grey-green eyes, straight brows and a closed steady mouth. Hair: black, in a long plait tied with grey string and hanging over one shoulder. Body: strong and steady, sitting upright at the oars with a straight back and long steady arms. Clothing: a clean pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp tied up at the knee, and a thin reed cape pinned with a bone pin. Hands and objects: both brown, firm hands on two oars blackened with age. Background: quiet evening water with ripples and a low isle, blurred. The water is a calm sheet of copper and pale pink under a low sky, a small green isle sits dark on the horizon and a single heron stands motionless on a post near the shore. Light: soft red-gold light from the upper left, with its ripples on the water. Qi: a faint blue-grey shimmer. Expression: steady and unhurried, the pale eyes level and the mouth closed, a compassionate, stubborn girl who has already decided to keep her promise.

people.imagined: Blushing at praise; his palms held the glow to full dark at the first try.
people.subject: The moment: standing with his eyes lowered, he blushes and glances at the viewer, the examiner having told him not to boast; he holds his palms out a little way as though he does not quite trust them, and the glow flickers on them like a candle in a draught, while behind him a river child watches with open envy. Face: a plain, kind, round face with red-flushed cheeks and reddening ears, shy dark eyes, thick straight brows and an embarrassed half-smile. Hair: black, short and flat on one side. Body: stocky and solid, standing with his shoulders drawn in and his heels together. Clothing: a clean, new pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp with a plain brown sash. Hands and objects: both palms held shyly out and faintly glowing yellow-brown, as if apologising. Background: a blurred steppe at dusk. Behind him the steppe is a wide plain of yellow grass fading into violet dusk, a few tents stand small in the distance and a young river child watches from the edge of the frame. Light: warm low dusk light from the upper left. Qi: a faint brown-gold shimmer. Expression: shy and humble, the lips pressed together to hide a pleased smile and the eyes unable to meet the viewer's for more than a moment, a calm boy startled by his own gift.

people.imagined: Practising in the noon sun with a pink forehead to prove the examiner is unfair.
people.subject: The moment: under noon sun, she practises a stance and glares at the viewer, her forehead sunburnt, the sun high and the examiner unfair, and she practising still. Face (most important: a bright pink sunburnt forehead): a thin, fierce face with narrow dark eyes that burn, heavy straight brows, thin cheeks, a peeling nose and a set mouth with the lips pressed white. Hair: black, in a tight high tail tied with a red cord and wet at the ends. Body: wiry and lean, her knees bent in a low stance with her feet wide and her shoulders square. Clothing: a clean pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp, the sleeves rolled above the elbow and the collar soaked and clinging darkly to her neck. Hands and objects: her fists tight with white knuckles, sweat dripping from her chin and running down the pink forehead into an eyebrow. Background: a blurred bare steppe under a hot white sky, with a single dry thorn tree far off, its shadow a tiny black dot. Light: hard white noon light from above left, almost no shadow. Qi: a faint orange-brown shimmer. Expression: a steady, resentful glare, the jaw clenched and the eyes unblinking, an ambitious, diligent girl whose whole face says she will prove the examiner wrong.

people.imagined: Hopeful smile, maple sap on his cuffs, a bucket tipping over somewhere near him.
people.subject: The moment: holding a wooden sap bucket, he smiles hopefully at the viewer as the bucket tips and a branch drops behind him, the roster having lost his name again. Face: a round, open, sun-brown face with wide brown eyes, raised thick brows, a weak chin and a nervous hopeful smile. Hair: brown, a tangle with a leaf stuck in it. Body: tall and lanky, swaying a little as though ready to catch something that falls. Clothing: a pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp with amber sap stains on both cuffs and a larger stain on the front. Hands and objects: a wooden sap bucket with an iron band tipping in his hand, amber sap dripping on his wrist; behind him a branch has just fallen. Background: a blurred grove of maples with falling leaves. Maples in full red and amber stand in rows behind him, drifts of fallen leaves cover the ground, a second bucket hangs from a trunk and a thin tin spout shines where it was driven into the bark. Light: warm gold light from the upper left through the maples. Qi: a faint green-gold shimmer. Expression: a hopeful, cautious, unlucky smile, the eyes wide and the brows raised in advance apology, a humble young man who expects the next small disaster and meets it politely.

people.imagined: A dice cup rattles in his sleeve as he asks a favour with a smile.
people.subject: The moment: leaning one shoulder on a post with one foot crossed over the other, he shakes a small dice cup in one hand and grins slyly at the viewer, having just asked a favour while the dice rattle in his sleeve. Face: a sly, handsome, narrow face with quick dark eyes, thin arched brows and a lopsided grin. Hair: black, in a loose knot tied with a red cord, strands hanging at his ears. Body: slim and loose-limbed, lounging. Clothing: a rumpled but clean pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp with a gaudy yellow sash tied in a showy bow, and a bit of dice-string hanging from his belt. Hands and objects: a small bamboo dice cup with a leather band in the right hand, two bone dice showing a pair of sixes; a bright coin in the left. Background: a blurred market alley with hanging lanterns.
