The alley behind him is narrow and crowded with stalls, strings of paper lanterns in red and yellow hang overhead, and the blurred shapes of a few passers-by and a fruit seller fill the far end. Light: warm lantern light from the upper left. Qi: a faint brown shimmer. Expression: a sly, stubborn, greedy grin, one brow cocked and the eyes bright with calculation, the easy charm of a young man who never asks without a plan to collect.

people.imagined: Red dust on her sandals, holding the glow easily, rather be digging a well.
people.subject: The moment: standing with a spade, she gives the viewer a plain cheerful look, having stopped to wipe her forehead with the back of her wrist and left a red streak of clay there; she would rather be digging a well. Face: a round, wholesome, tanned face with honest bright straight dark eyes, thick brows, a snub nose, a round chin and a wide open smile. Hair: black, in a short braid tied with a bit of cloth and hanging down her back. Body: sturdy and strong-armed, standing square with broad shoulders and strong forearms. Clothing: a clean pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp tied up at the knee, with the hem and her sandals stained red by clay dust. Hands and objects: both hands on the handle of a well-digger's spade whose dull blade is caked with red clay. Background: a blurred steppe with a half-dug well-shaft, a plank frame and a bucket on a rope. Beyond the well the steppe rolls away in pale gold grass under a wide clear sky, a few distant sheep are specks on a rise, and a pile of red clay stands beside the shaft with a second spade stuck in it. Light: bright light from the upper left on the steppe. Qi: a faint brown shimmer. Expression: a broad, easy, unbothered grin, brave and content, a girl glad to be outdoors with a spade in her hands.

people.imagined: Half asleep with straw in his hair during dusk practice, eyelids at half-mast.
people.subject: The moment: sitting up from a doze, he blinks drowsily at the viewer, the dusk practice going on a few paces off while he has slid down against a post with his chin on his chest, a cow's bell hanging on a cord from his belt as a memory of the herds of Ngưu Đẩu. Face: a round, sleepy, tanned face with half-lowered lids, thick brows, a soft chin, a lazy smile and a dribble of drool. Hair: brown, with several straws stuck in it, clearly visible. Body: big and soft, slumped against the post with his legs stretched out. Clothing: a pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp, creased from sleeping and hanging open at the neck. Hands and objects: one hand rubs an eye while the other props up his chin. Background: a blurred dusk yard with a post and, behind him, a row of figures kneeling in the half-dark, their palms glowing faintly. A packed-earth yard with a splintered hitching post, a bucket and a long low roof edge at the far side, the dusk sky pale orange above the kneeling figures. Light: warm low light from the upper left. Qi: a faint brown shimmer. Expression: a lazy, trusting, good-natured half-smile with the eyes at half mast, a boy with no idea that he is being looked at.

people.imagined: Rolling his sleeves to the same fold, witnessing a seal, asked a polite question about oaths.
people.subject: The moment: rolling a sleeve to a precise fold, he looks at the viewer with an earnest cautious look, having been asked which oath broke first, and setting a stamp on a sheet beside him. Face: a neat, young, pale face with careful grey eyes, straight brows and thin precise lips. Hair: black, in a tidy topknot fastened straight with a bone pin. Body: slim and neat, standing exactly straight with his shoulders level and his chin tucked. Clothing: a rust inner-gate robe of fine hemp with a flat clean dusk-violet collar, the cuffs folded to exactly the same width of two fingers. Hands and objects: both hands set a small dark wooden stamp with a round face on a sheet of paper, the corner pinned under his forefinger. Background: a blurred plain hall. The hall behind him is plain pale plastered wall with a single dark wooden bench, a low table with a brass lamp and a folded cloth, and nothing on the wall but a bare hook. Light: cool light from the upper left. Qi: a faint grey shimmer. Expression: careful, honest and cautious, the eyes level and the lips thin, the look of a just young man who dislikes answering questions he cannot check.

people.imagined: Holding one palm flat as if weighing the air, testing a note by its weight.
people.subject: The moment: holding her palm flat and level in front of her, she studies the viewer as if weighing them, a thin paper note resting on her palm and weighing light. Face: a sharp, pale, narrow face with narrowed calculating eyes, thin brows, a thin nose and a thin line of mouth. Hair: black, in a sleek low knot held by a black pin. Body: slim and poised, standing very upright with one hand held out flat and perfectly steady. Clothing: a crisp rust inner-gate robe of fine hemp with a dusk-violet collar, a pale ochre sash knotted exactly and a tiny brass scale pinned at the collar. Hands and objects: the right palm held out flat with the note on it, its edge faintly curling; the other hand hovers above it. Background: blurred market office shelves of boxes. Behind her shelves of lacquered boxes in rust and ochre climb to the ceiling, each with a small brass lock, and the corner of a heavy counting table with an abacus shows at the frame edge. Light: cool light from the upper left. Qi: a faint brown shimmer. Expression: wary and greedy, the narrowed eyes weighing and the mouth set, a diligent woman who does not trust any value she has not held in her own hand.

people.imagined: Carrying a lamp in the galleries with a limp from a cave-in, lamp-soot in the corners of her eyes.
people.subject: The moment: in a dark gallery, she raises a lamp and limps a step toward the viewer, a limp from a cave-in, looking toward the locked door with a fresh scuff of dust on its sill. Face (most important: lamp-soot in the corners of both eyes): a brave, plain face with trusting dark eyes, thick brows and a firm mouth, a smear of soot at each eye corner. Hair: black, in a messy knot tied with a bit of cord and dusty. Body: small and wiry, favouring her left leg. Clothing: a rust inner-gate robe of fine hemp with a dusk-violet collar, dusty, the hem scuffed pale by the gallery floor. Hands and objects: one hand holds up a battered tin lamp with a steady yellow flame; the other leans on a short silver-pine prop. Background: a blurred dark timbered gallery with props. Ahead of her the gallery narrows between rough stone walls and dark timber props, a heavy iron-bound door waits at the end of the lamp's reach and the roof above sags with shadow. Light: warm yellow lamp light from below lighting her face under the chin. Qi: a faint silver-grey shimmer. Expression: determined and a little frightened, the eyes wide and the mouth firm, a brave, trusting woman walking toward a door she was told to avoid.

people.imagined: Standing very still like someone who has heard everything, holding a kettle, thin tea in the caddy.
people.subject: The moment: standing very still with a kettle in both hands, she gazes calmly at the viewer, topping the caddy with spent leaves, a woman who has heard everything and will say none of it. Face: a pale, lined, still face with thin lashes, patient dark unblinking eyes that give nothing, thin brows and a tiny closed mouth. Hair: grey-white, in a tight low bun pinned with a plain wood pin. Body: small, thin and upright, motionless, her elbows tucked in. Clothing: a plain rust servant's robe of fine hemp, old but spotless, with a long clean white apron tied over it. Hands and objects: both hands hold an old black iron tea kettle with a bent handle and a chip in the spout; a wooden tea caddy on the table beside her. Background: a blurred small tea room. The small room behind her has a low wooden table with a bamboo mat, a shelf of mismatched cups, a hanging towel and a window with a pale paper blind glowing softly. Light: soft light from the upper left. Qi: a faint brown shimmer. Expression: patient and unreadable, nothing showing on her face, the stillness of a loyal old servant who keeps other people's secrets by never reacting to them.

people.imagined: Serving at a guest's elbow with a forgettable face and a tray held exactly right.
people.subject: The moment: holding a tray exactly at the height of the viewer's elbow, she smiles forgettably, having set it beside a rope-buyer so softly he did not notice, and she will repeat every word he says, adding a line of her own to please. Face: a forgettable, even, pleasant face with soft brown eyes, level brows and a small smile. Hair: black, in a plain bun tied with a brown cord. Body: slim, quiet and neat, standing lightly. Clothing: a spotless rust servant's tunic of fine hemp with the sleeves tied back with a plain cord and a clean white apron. Hands and objects: both hands hold a tray with a white china teapot with a blue ring and two small plain cups. Background: a blurred guest room with a window over a gorge. Behind her a window opens over a mist-filled gorge, a polished dark-wood floor reflects the pale glow, and the empty guest cushion beside the table is set with a folded napkin. Light: a soft grey glow from a paper window lighting her pale cheek. Qi: a faint brown shimmer. Expression: a pleasant look that never changes, the smile fixed and only the quick attentive eyes showing that she is listening to everything.

people.imagined: Oiling a maple stump in the autumn, smelling of maple oil, sitting later in the kitchen.
people.subject: The moment: kneeling by a cut maple stump with an oil cloth, he looks up peacefully at the viewer, having oiled this stump every autumn since he was a boy and humming a tune without words as the rings darken under his cloth. Face: a sunken, weathered, brown, peaceful face with hollow cheeks, faded kind eyes, sparse brows and a toothless smile. Hair: thin grey, tied in a wisp with a bit of twine. Body: bent and thin, kneeling slowly with one hand on the stump to steady himself. Clothing: a faded pale ochre servant's robe of hemp, clean and soft, smelling of maple oil. Hands and objects: one hand holds a folded cloth shining with oil on the stump's pale rings, which are dark and glossy. Background: a blurred old courtyard of pale flagstones strewn with red maple leaves, a low plastered wall along one side and a kitchen door open on a warm dark interior. Light: low gold autumn sun from the upper left that lights the oil on the stump like honey. Qi: a faint green-gold shimmer. Expression: a peace so complete that the toothless smile seems to come from the wood itself, devout, patient and content.

people.imagined: A dawn-red ribbon in her braid, announcing she will not be sold, choosing bench-mates from a hat of names.
people.subject: The moment: with her chin high, she lifts a small cloth hat of folded paper slips and smiles boldly at the viewer, announcing she will not be sold, having marked the names in the hat for choosing bench-mates. Face: a bold, pretty, round face with bright dark eyes, arched brows, a small nose, a confident wide smile and a small mole at the corner of the mouth. Hair: black, in a thick braid tied with a bright dawn-red ribbon, clearly visible. Body: sturdy and confident, standing with her chin lifted and her feet apart. Clothing: a clean pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp with a rust sash tied in a firm bow and a dawn-red ribbon matching the one in her braid. Hands and objects: one hand holds a brown cloth hat full of folded slips, shaking it a little; the other on her hip. Background: a blurred outer-gate yard with a stove-side bench. Behind her the outer-gate yard is packed pale earth with a long bench beside a brick stove, other girls in ochre robes watching from the bench and a thin plume of stove smoke rising. Light: bright light from the upper left. Qi: a faint brown shimmer. Expression: a bold, ambitious, arbitrary smile, the chin up and the eyes sparkling, a girl who intends to choose her own company and enjoys the power of the draw.

people.imagined: A rope burn across his left palm that has never closed, offering to go back into the grey.
people.subject: The moment: holding up his left palm to show a raw rope burn, he looks steadily at the viewer, the rope having gone slack in his hand that day and him still feeling it, offering to go back into the grey. Face (most important: a red unhealed rope burn across the left palm): a young, pale, wary face with shadowed eyes, thick brows drawn together and a set mouth. Hair: black, short and rough. Body: lean and taut, narrow, with his shoulders raised and his feet planted. Clothing: a clean pale ochre outer-gate robe of sturdy hemp with the cuffs creased by the rope and a grey scarf wrapped twice around the neck. Hands and objects: the left palm raised with the raw red burn across it, clearly visible; a coil of coarse brown rope with an unravelled end on the other shoulder. Background: a blurred grey mist thickening into a wall at the edge of the ash plain, a few black stakes leaning in the haze and a pale trail of footprints leading out of the frame toward it. Light: pale cold light from the left. Qi: a faint blue-grey shimmer. Expression: wary, loyal and brave, the mouth set and the eyes shadowed, a young man ready to walk back into the grey because he cannot forgive the rope.
